markers.name: Acnovo
markers.yearly_cost: USD 30/mo (USD 360/yr)
markers.user_note: In August 2026 a University of Zulia geodesy group reported the Maracaibo base broadcasting a position 1.18 m off its own solution in ellipsoidal height; rovers on that base inherit the offset in absolute height.

markers.name: ACOR (American Center of Research)
markers.region: the Irbid, Amman, Karak and Wadi Musa areas
markers.conditions_note: Access is requested by e-mail. Whether it is free, who may use it and the caster address are not published.

markers.name: AD-GRS (Abu Dhabi GNSS Reference Stations)
markers.yearly_cost: price on request
markers.user_note: Abu Dhabi City Municipality lists the subscription among its services for companies.

markers.name: DVRS (Dubai Virtual Reference Station)
markers.yearly_cost: price on request
markers.user_note: Dubai Municipality describes requests for the corrections as coming from surveyors.

markers.name: Afghanistan — no public network
markers.user_note: A World Bank-financed national network of initially 11 reference stations was halted at the purchasing stage when the project stopped with the change of government in August 2021.

markers.name: CORS AFOR (RECI)
markers.user_note: A launch offer of free use ran to December 2022; the portal states no terms or price. Users reported in 2022 were survey firms AFOR contracted for land work.

markers.name: EarthScope Barbuda station (CN00)
markers.user_note: EarthScope's own archive needs a free account; the US National Geodetic Survey's archive carries the same station's files without one.

markers.name: Africa Geonetworks (AGL CORS)
markers.user_note: aglcors.com publishes a caster address, port and shared login, yet also speaks of registration and subscriptions; neither the caster nor the registration site answered when checked, and its only price names no real currency.

markers.name: AgrarNET
markers.yearly_cost: CHF 690/yr for the 1st licence, CHF 550 for a 2nd, both ex-VAT; optional data SIM CHF 140
markers.user_note: Marketed for farm auto-steering, but sold on its own with no farming condition stated. GVS Agrar publishes no station list or reference frame, and does not say whether it uses NTRIP or is network RTK or single-base.

markers.name: AgriSat
markers.region: most of France, by the operator's account
markers.yearly_cost: €690/yr ex-VAT, one flat rate (tariff dated April 2022)
markers.user_note: Aimed at agricultural professionals. The operator confirms coverage at a location through its contact form. Annual contract, renewed automatically unless cancelled a month ahead.

markers.name: AgroNet RTK
markers.yearly_cost: 76,200 HUF/yr incl. VAT, no SIM (~USD 242); 10 days' credit 11,430 HUF, usable within a year; 1 day 1,270 HUF
markers.user_note: A farm-parts seller's service, open to any NTRIP-compatible receiver by its own account. It publishes a station count but no positions, and host and mountpoints arrive only after purchase.

markers.name: AGROS (RGZ)
markers.yearly_cost: 145,480 RSD/yr (~USD 1,370); 47,660 RSD/yr (~USD 450) on the agricultural and construction machinery tier; 26,440 RSD/month (~USD 250). Statutory administrative fee, per receiver, with no VAT added
markers.user_note: In 2022 the online application form offered two kinds of applicant: a surveyor, giving a company registration and tax number, or a farmer, giving an agricultural-holding number. The fee statute itself sets no qualification.
markers.datum_epoch: SRB_ETRS89 (ETRS89 realised as ETRF2000, epoch 2010.63). The GK mount also sends parameters for the legacy Gauss-Krüger projection.

markers.name: AGROS RINEX (EUREF stations)
markers.user_note: Daily and hourly files at 30-second sampling from the EUREF Permanent Network's data centres, with no account; RGZ's own RINEX service costs a statutory 1,990 RSD (about USD 19) an hour.
markers.datum_epoch: ETRF2000 positions and velocities per station, published by EUREF

markers.name: AGRS.BES (Kadaster Nederland)
markers.user_note: Short mountpoint names: RTCM 3.1, GPS and GLONASS only. Bonaire's island-grid transformation (BESTRANS2020) is rated better than 0.1 m horizontally only for RTK against BON200BES0; without that base, e.g. PPP-RTK, it leaves a sub-metre offset.
markers.datum_epoch: Bonaire 2004 = ITRF2000 (epoch 2001.5) on Bonaire; BES2020 = ITRF2014 (epoch 2020.0) on Saba and Sint Eustatius

creds.userNote: optional: your e-mail address, for notice of changes and major outages

markers.name: AITOYA BASE
markers.user_note: The operator publishes the base's position from static positioning, naming no datum.

markers.name: ALBCORS
markers.yearly_cost: 60,000 lek/yr (~USD 735); 8,000 lek/month; 2,000 lek one-off per registered receiver
markers.user_note: The 2025 tariff decree offers it to individuals and firms for geodetic, engineering and scientific work; the registration form makes every field mandatory, company and NIPT (business tax number) included.

markers.name: SAAP (Institut National de Cartographie et de Télédétection)
markers.user_note: Corrections run only over national mobile VPN links, for account holders with a VPN SIM; INCT's SAAP page gives no eligibility rule or price. Decree 09-410 puts acquiring and operating satellite-positioning equipment under state authorisation.

markers.name: AllDayRTK
markers.yearly_cost: From AUD 400 + GST per rover per year (AUD 440 incl GST, ~USD 300), 12-month term, auto-renewing; a reseller's price, Aptella publishes no rates. 30-day free trial.
markers.user_note: Most of its Australian stations are also streamed by AUSCORS. Its licence covers use in the normal course of the subscriber's business, for surveying and related activities, including automated control of farm and construction machinery.
markers.datum_epoch: GDA2020(2020.0) on the per-state hosts named with 2020 (vic2020.alldayrtk.com.au), GDA94 on the others (vic.alldayrtk.com.au)

markers.name: ANCFCC – Réseau GNSS Permanent
markers.yearly_cost: price on request
markers.user_note: ANCFCC's site gives no caster address and does not say whether an individual can buy the real-time service. Station data is sold at seven sales points. ANCFCC ordered a private network, itri, to stop in 2022; itri's websites no longer exist.

markers.name: ANGOCORS
markers.region: sites in Angola the operator does not locate publicly
markers.yearly_cost: 96,000 AOA/yr (~USD 105) or 8,000 AOA/month (~USD 9) — 1 device, 360 h/month; 360,000 AOA/yr (~USD 395) — 5 devices, 672 h/month
markers.user_note: The caster's station list falls well short of the 18 active stations and national coverage the website advertises.

markers.name: APOS — Austrian Positioning Service
markers.yearly_cost: €200/month, €20/day or €0.0015/s, ex-VAT; €50 one-time setup per account
markers.user_note: Free for agricultural and forestry holdings, contractors and machinery rings, for farm and forest work only; registration runs through eAMA. Each device needs its own account.

markers.name: APOS-PP — Austrian Positioning Service post-processing data
markers.user_note: No registration needed. One-second files stay online for 60 days and 30-second files for two years; older 30-second day files only on request, subject to availability.

markers.name: ARMPOS
markers.user_note: Built for the state cadastre; the Cadastre Committee lists no positioning service among the national services it provides.

markers.name: National Park Service GNSS
markers.user_note: Hourly 1-second files need no account. Live corrections from this station need an account: self-registration is switched off, accounts are created on e-mail request, and the portal does not say who qualifies.

markers.name: ASG-EUPOS
markers.user_note: The sign-up form returned an error page when tried in July, October and November 2026. It asks for a short company or organisation name but no business registration, and an administrator activates each account after checking the details.

creds.userNote: your company name/user name, as in GUGiK/jkowalski

markers.name: ASI fiducial GNSS network
markers.user_note: ASI provides the streams primarily for demonstration and evaluation and may interrupt them without notice; credentials are for personal use and take a few days to arrive.

markers.name: Asiaq — Greenland Survey
markers.user_note: The caster's own listing declares the stream free and password-protected; Asiaq's website does not mention the service.

markers.name: AUSCORS
markers.region: Australia and New Zealand, plus partner stations re-streamed from dozens of other countries
markers.user_note: After registering, Geoscience Australia asks users to contact its team to arrange permissions for their use-case. The caster flags most Victorian streams as needing a fee; Geoscience Australia and Victoria both call single-base access free.

markers.name: Axis GPS
markers.yearly_cost: price on request
markers.user_note: Marketed to surveyors and survey offices, with no individual tier published, though the operator reports hundreds of other users.

markers.name: AzPOS
markers.yearly_cost: price on request
markers.user_note: Individuals as well as companies may apply. Use rests on an agreement made with each applicant, and RTK ordered on the operator's portal stays inactive until the State Service on Property Issues activates it.

markers.name: FBiHPOS
markers.region: the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina
markers.yearly_cost: 1,000 KM/yr (~USD 569); 250 KM/month; 150 KM for 7 days — per receiver, plus a one-off 100 KM registration
markers.user_note: The online sign-up requires a company name, an identity-card serial number and a Bosnian personal identification number (JMB); the downloadable application form's section for private individuals asks for none of these.

markers.name: SRPOS
markers.yearly_cost: 1,000 KM/yr (~USD 569); 250 KM/month; 30 KM for 10 h used within a month — all per receiver
markers.user_note: The online form asks for a company name, a company registration number and a tax number; the operator's note under the two number fields gives 007 as the entry for private individuals.

markers.name: Survey of Bangladesh GNSS CORS
markers.region: the areas around Dhaka, Chattogram, Khulna, Rajshahi, Rangpur and Maulvibazar
markers.yearly_cost: BDT 30,000/year per receiver, ex-VAT (~USD 250); BDT 10,000/quarter (~USD 83); BDT 5,000/month (~USD 42)
markers.user_note: In October 2026 the operator's live station map showed all but one of its stations unhealthy, and its online sign-up reported itself unavailable.

markers.name: FLEPOS
markers.conditions_note: Professional organisations only, not private individuals: Belgian ones register with their enterprise (KBO) number, foreign ones with a number known to their own government. Each subscription type must match the organisation's business purpose.
markers.user_note: The terms exclude mass-consumer applications with many customers, naming smartphones, IoT devices and lawn mowers. The operator strongly advises against RTK use outside its service area.

markers.name: WALCORS
markers.region: Wallonia, Brussels and southern Flanders, with countrywide access
markers.conditions_note: Free for positioning use; guidance uses (auto-steer, machine guidance, machine control) are a chargeable tier, sold through private resellers.
markers.user_note: Corrections are delivered only inside Belgium.

markers.name: BF-CORS
markers.user_note: RTCM 3.1, GPS and GLONASS only. IGB has not published access terms for the open streams. In October 2026 the VRSRTCM32 and MultiStation_RTCM31 mounts gave neither a network solution nor the nearest station.

markers.name: 1Yocto
markers.yearly_cost: EUR 640/yr, EUR 100/month, or EUR 55 for a 10-hour prepaid pack, all ex-VAT
markers.user_note: The operator takes orders by phone or e-mail rather than through an online checkout, and issues credentials after a bank transfer.

markers.name: GeoNet
markers.yearly_cost: EUR 600/yr unlimited, EUR 105/month, or EUR 15/month with 150 minutes on a 24-month term, all ex-VAT
markers.user_note: Credentials are issued after a contract is signed, though a test profile with temporary credentials can be set up on request. The tariff carries no prepaid hour pack.

markers.name: GEOVARA
markers.yearly_cost: EUR 615/yr, or EUR 410/yr for Hi-Target, Satlab and Topcon receivers; EUR 122.71/month; EUR 81.81 for 10 hours. All ex-VAT
markers.user_note: Subscriptions and hour packs are sold through a card checkout.

markers.name: HxGN SmartNet Bulgaria (СмартБул.Нет)
markers.yearly_cost: EUR 613.55/yr, EUR 122.71/month, or EUR 122.71 for a 20-hour prepaid pack, all ex-VAT
markers.user_note: The Bulgarian stations belong to Vekom Geo, which takes orders by phone or e-mail rather than online, and offers a free test subscription on request.

markers.name: National Permanent GNSS Network (НГИЦ)
markers.user_note: Operated for crustal-movement research, the stations log observation files. The National Geoinformation Centre calls the data freely available by file transfer but publishes no address and no way to request access.

markers.name: SLRB Permanent Reference Network
markers.user_note: SLRB says charges may be introduced. The online request offers an Individual applicant type, though the application form asks for organisation details. Each access permission covers one device.

markers.name: Ministerio de Bienes Nacionales
markers.user_note: Opens without an account or form, with files at one-second as well as 30-second intervals. The ministry's 2025 announcement described the stations' coordinate sheets as certified by the Instituto Geográfico Militar.

markers.name: IGN Bénin
markers.user_note: In October 2026 the station-data portal's sign-up form returned a maintenance error and IGN's own status page flagged most stations' live output as unhealthy. Benin's state service catalogue lists IGN's counter as a channel for station files.

markers.name: Jabatan Ukur (Survey Department)
markers.yearly_cost: BND 1,000/year (~USD 780); BND 100/month (~USD 78)
markers.user_note: RTK is ordered on the department's general geomatics supply form (UKUR087), whose public section asks for a Brunei identity-card number. The station count and VRS service are described in a 2016 department presentation.

markers.name: MARGEN-ROC
markers.user_note: The download form asks for a Bolivian identity-card (CI) number and offers no foreign-document alternative. On each of two dates in 2026, the same eight of the 29 stations held no data.

markers.name: BrandtNet
markers.yearly_cost: price on request

markers.name: Department of Lands and Surveys reference network
markers.user_note: The 23-station figure comes from a software vendor's project profile, not from the department.

markers.name: DrukNet (NLCS)
markers.yearly_cost: Basic Nu. 10,000/year (~USD 120), one user; Standard Nu. 17,500 (~USD 210), two users; Premium Nu. 22,500 (~USD 270), three users
markers.user_note: The tiers count users, not streams: one subscription holds a single connection at a time, regardless of tier. Teaching and research use is free against an official document proving the purpose. The tariff names no tier for individuals.
markers.datum_epoch: DrukRef23 (ITRF2020, epoch 2023.5); the former national frame DrukRef03 (ITRF2000, epoch 2003) differs by up to ~1 m, bridged by NLCS's free NTv2 grid.

markers.name: Department of Surveys and Mapping
markers.user_note: On the regional mapping centre RCMRD's 2025 map, 32 of its stations carry a real-time flag and 20 do not. The network's portal, www.cors.gov.bw, did not answer from Namibia, South Africa, Kenya or Europe in October 2026.

markers.name: Belgeodesiya (ССТП РБ)
markers.yearly_cost: Flat plan 150.78 BYN/month (~USD 50), its tariff worded for on-board navigation equipment; general plan 0.24 BYN per minute (14.40 BYN/h, ~USD 4.78); RINEX 3.63 BYN per one-hour station file (~USD 1.21). All ex-VAT.
markers.user_note: The operator's public offer covers Belarusian residents only; non-residents negotiate an individual foreign-trade contract. No online self-service: logins are issued against a signed handover record, with a briefing by the Minsk service centre.

markers.name: Belgeodesiya RINEX (EUREF)
markers.user_note: Downloads need no account, contract or Belarusian residency.
markers.datum_epoch: EUREF station positions in ETRF2000, ETRF2020 or IGc20, epoch 2020.0; the owner's own frame is ITRF2005, epoch 2008-04-23

markers.name: SmartNet
markers.yearly_cost: price on request
markers.user_note: The online store shows a price only after a buyer registers an account.

markers.name: TopNET Live
markers.yearly_cost: price on request

markers.name: City of Calgary DART
markers.user_note: The city publishes no service page, price or terms for the network.

markers.name: Can-Net
markers.region: southern Canada, British Columbia to the Atlantic
markers.yearly_cost: price on request

markers.name: CENACARTA
markers.user_note: A 2020 tender to upgrade the 11-station network specified NTRIP and post-processing for registered subscribers, the general public included. Delivery is undocumented: CENACARTA has no reachable website and has published no caster address or tariff.

markers.name: Centipede-RTK
markers.region: France and Hungary, with sparser bases across Europe and beyond
markers.user_note: In Europe, ETRF2000 and ITRF base coordinates differ by roughly a metre, so moving between such bases, NEAR's switches included, shifts results as much. Bases missing from the caster's mount list stream positions the operator has not yet checked.
markers.datum_epoch: Per base, in the frame its owner declared: France, and most Swiss and Belgian bases, RGF93 v2b = ETRF2000 (2019.0); most other European bases ETRF2000 at their own observation epoch, some ITRF2014/ITRF2020 or a national frame; Canada and USA NAD83; French overseas mostly the territory's legal frame; elsewhere ITRF2014/ITRF2020, Australia GDA2020.

markers.name: China Mobile OnePoint (移动CORS)
markers.region: mainland China, except a few uninhabited areas
markers.yearly_cost: about CNY 1,688/yr (~USD 240), reseller reference prices from 2022–23
markers.user_note: Resellers also list 1-, 3-, 7- and 30-day accounts. A direct account has needed a Chinese mobile number and a real-name check.
markers.datum_epoch: CGCS2000(2000.0), with ITRF2008(2016.0) and WGS84(2005.0) on other ports of the same caster

markers.name: Government reference-station networks (national and provincial)
markers.user_note: Hunan, Guangxi and Guizhou admit only organisations, mostly with a surveying qualification, which a private person cannot hold.

markers.name: RoverConnect
markers.yearly_cost: R$2,690/yr (~USD 503), R$355/mo (~USD 66) by PIX or bank slip, about 11% more by card; R$45/day (~USD 8)
markers.user_note: Credentials can take up to 24 hours after the purchase is confirmed.

markers.name: IGN-CR (SNIT)
markers.conditions_note: IGN's 2024 manual offers the caster to the general public. A 2025 paper says it is restricted to Costa Rican professionals; an IGN-signed 2025 guide has only professionals creating a SNIT account. The first sign-up step asks for no licence or ID.
markers.user_note: New accounts activate at 00:00 or 12:00 local, up to 12 hours after signup. SNIT passwords expire every 90 days, which may stop a rover's saved login. The number of stations on the caster varied between 10 and 14 during 2026.
markers.datum_epoch: CR-SIRGAS — corrections are served in the operational frame ITRF2014, epoch 2019.24; the datum's official frame is IGb08, epoch 2014.59

markers.name: PX GNSS
markers.yearly_cost: no network fee; comes with PX receivers, one-off: rover package USD 1,404 ex-VAT (equipment only USD 1,062 ex-VAT), base and rover USD 2,646 ex-VAT
markers.user_note: Renting a PX receiver for one week, two weeks or a month also includes the network. The operator says receivers of several brands can use it; terms for them are by contact.

markers.name: Capital Regional District RTK
markers.yearly_cost: CAD 1,200/yr per SIM + CAD 200 one-time setup; tax not stated
markers.user_note: Each rover connection needs an active cellular SIM with a static IP address. Access is requested by e-mail to the district's helpdesk.

markers.name: Cross River State CORS
markers.yearly_cost: price on request
markers.user_note: A 2025 state notice requires all geospatial data work in Cross River, including GIS and property surveys, to connect to this network by subscription. Its web portal showed a suspended account in October 2026.

markers.name: Centro Sismológico Nacional (CSN)
markers.user_note: Some stations also stream in real time through EarthScope. The operator's 2017 announcement addresses scientific and technical users and mentions no fee or registration.

markers.name: CyCLOPS
markers.user_note: A Cyprus University of Technology research network for monitoring ground movement and geological hazards.

markers.name: CYPOS
markers.yearly_cost: EUR 238/yr, or EUR 142.80/6 mo, per receiver
markers.user_note: Subscribing needs a CY Login profile validated at a Citizen Service Centre (for companies, a Central Post Office). CY Login's in-person check for individuals takes a Cypriot ID card, a residence permit or an EU-citizen registration certificate.
markers.datum_epoch: ITRF2014 on the mountpoints with ITRF2014 in their name

markers.name: CZEPOS
markers.yearly_cost: 10,000 CZK/yr per device (~USD 457); or 1,000 CZK/mo per device (~USD 46); or 60 CZK/h, billed per second (~USD 2.7)
markers.user_note: Signing up takes a signed application form; the account opens once the form is received, and use is invoiced afterwards. Students preparing a thesis get it free to the necessary extent, on a written request their school confirms.

markers.name: GPSnet.dk
markers.yearly_cost: 6,995 DKK/yr ex-VAT (8,744 DKK incl. 25% VAT, ~USD 1,300); short-term logins 1,995 DKK/month or 995 DKK/week ex-VAT
markers.user_note: Sales, including the free 7-day demo, go only to businesses and institutions with a CVR number. Firms developing autonomous devices can get free access, for development and testing only, by contacting Geoteam.

markers.name: Klimadatastyrelsen GNSS
markers.user_note: Registration is a written request to the agency's geodesy office rather than a form; the invitation to write sets out no eligibility conditions and no terms of use. RINEX from the same stations requires a free Dataforsyningen account.

markers.name: RTKconnect
markers.yearly_cost: 5,000 DKK/yr ex-VAT through the Agroassist reseller (6,250 DKK incl. 25% VAT, ~USD 910), 3,500 DKK/yr ex-VAT per access when buying several there; 6,599 DKK/yr ex-VAT direct from the operator (8,249 DKK incl. VAT)
markers.user_note: Agroassist's page sells it as RTKassist without naming RTKconnect; orders go through its contact page. A login moves between devices, one connected at a time. Direct buyers can get a refund within 14 days if the network fails with their equipment.

markers.name: DLAM CORS (Department of Land Administration and Management)
markers.user_note: Built for land registration. The department earns income from leasing it, and who may lease is not stated. UniqTeK of Vientiane, with IGN FI, holds the 2022 contract to operate and maintain the stations.

markers.name: Ministry of Lands & Mineral Resources
markers.user_note: In 2022 the Surveyor General said no regulation covered access to the station data; in 2025 a data plan covering access and sharing was still work in progress.

markers.name: DOL-RTK Network (Department of Lands)
markers.user_note: The sign-up form takes a 13-digit Thai ID card number and a photo of that card or of an employee card, and has no passport field. Public sign-up is labelled a trial, with no length or end date published.

markers.name: Dominica GNSSCORS
markers.user_note: From June to late October 2026 the registration page returned a maintenance error on every attempt. The operator, the Lands and Surveys Division, listed phone and e-mail contacts but no account procedure or eligibility rules on its public pages.

markers.name: EarthScope
markers.region: the areas around its stations, mostly in the western US, others in Alaska, Hawaii, Mexico, Central America, the Caribbean, Chile, Rwanda and Nepal
markers.conditions_note: Free for non-commercial use: the operator's page names scientific, educational and humanitarian use, and its agreement bars charging for the data or anything derived from it. Commercial licence: USD 1,000 a year plus tax per concurrent RTCM stream.
markers.user_note: Commercial use of the BINEX streams is free; they need converting to RTCM 3 and leave out Chile's. Chile's streams come and go; Rwanda's belong to a research project that calls itself temporary, its own dates ending May 2026.
markers.datum_epoch: ITRF2014 on every stream, not NAD83(2011), which differs by up to 1–2 m in the contiguous US; the NOTA stations carry a declared epoch of 2026-03-30, while the few stations outside NOTA, Chile's among them, carry best-estimate positions with no stated epoch

markers.name: Trimble VRS Now
markers.yearly_cost: from €1,195/yr unlimited ex-VAT (~€1,482 incl. 24% VAT); from €695/yr for 100 hours and from €2,995/yr Europe-wide, both ex-VAT; SIM card not included

markers.name: EFT CORS
markers.user_note: Basic access to the observation files is free with a registered account; 1-second data, extended access and the real-time corrections are paid.

markers.name: ANCFCC – Réseau GNSS Permanent
markers.yearly_cost: price on request
markers.user_note: ANCFCC's site gives no caster address for these stations and does not say whether an individual can buy the real-time service. Station data is sold at seven sales points, none in the territory.

markers.name: EPOSA
markers.yearly_cost: €2,500/yr, €250/month, €25/day or €0.002/s, ex-VAT; €50 one-time setup
markers.user_note: No online sign-up: a signed application form goes to EPOSA by e-mail. Network mountpoints are set up for ETRF or Austrian MGI zones, none for LV95, Liechtenstein's frame. Free agricultural licence on written proof of a holding, farm equipment only.

markers.name: ERGAND – PCAR
markers.user_note: Station coordinates are provisional. The Govern d'Andorra's website legal notice limits site contents to private, personal use and bars commercial use of the sites or any of their elements; it does not say whether that covers the correction streams.

markers.name: ERGAND – RULL
markers.user_note: The Govern d'Andorra's website legal notice limits site contents to private, personal use and bars commercial use of the sites or any of their elements; it does not say whether that covers the correction streams.

markers.name: ERGNSS / SPTR
markers.region: all of Spain, including the Balearics, the Canaries, Ceuta and Melilla
markers.user_note: IGN's sign-up link gave an error page in October 2026; the portal opens at http://ergnss.ign.es/gnuserportal/layout/index.zul. In the Balearics and Canaries IGN advises CERCANA3M over network solutions, which may be poorer across an archipelago.
markers.datum_epoch: ETRS89 realised as ETRF2000, epoch 2017.0, on the Peninsula, the Balearics, Ceuta and Melilla; REGCAN95 (realisation of 1 February 2024) in the Canaries

markers.name: Egyptian Survey Authority fixed-stations network
markers.region: Nile Valley, Delta and north coast
markers.user_note: Approved for post-processing; outside users have obtained its data from the Authority on request, at extra cost. Real-time operation was announced in 2023 for government and private-sector users, without a date, terms or price.

markers.name: ESTPOS
markers.user_note: Free real-time was a test period set to end on 31 August 2026; the operator's September 2026 manual lists no real-time service. RINEX covers the last 90 days, per station or at a chosen point. Orders are activated by hand; the manual states no price.
markers.datum_epoch: ETRS89 realised as EUREF-EST97 (parent ITRF96, epoch 1997.56); L-EST97 grid, EH2000 heights

markers.name: ETCORS
markers.region: Addis Ababa, Sheger City, Debre Berhan, Jimma, Bonga, Semera and Jigjiga
markers.yearly_cost: price on request
markers.user_note: The Space Science and Geospatial Institute's service page gives an enquiry address but no sign-up route or eligibility rule. At launch it named surveyors, researchers and mapping professionals as intended users; nothing stated excludes individuals.
markers.datum_epoch: Adindan (UTM 37N) on VRS_ADINDAN_37 and SSGI_Adindan_37N; EGM2008 heights on VRS_UTM37N_EGM2008

markers.name: EUREF-IP (EUREF Permanent Network)
markers.region: Europe and its islands, from the Azores to Cyprus and north to Svalbard
markers.user_note: Streams are offered best-effort, as raw data rather than an RTK service. Base coordinates are set by each station's operator; in Oct 2026 the network's daily check found half of them over 5 cm from the coordinates it publishes, 18% over 1 m.
markers.datum_epoch: ETRS89, realisation chosen per station; recommended: the country's latest, or ETRF2000 at 1 January of the current year.

markers.name: FINPOS RTK
markers.user_note: Granted only for fixed-term research and testing against a stated plan, never production. First-time users who simply want to test the service can be granted a one-off two-week trial. The stated reason: real-time positioning is left to companies.

markers.name: FINPOS RINEX
markers.user_note: Free to any registered user. Files can be generated for a chosen point rather than only downloaded per station; observations are kept at least nine months and generated files at least six. Data may not be passed on unchanged.

markers.name: HxGN SmartNet
markers.yearly_cost: price on request

markers.name: Karera RTKnet
markers.yearly_cost: €800/yr NRTK; €500/yr AGRI; €350 per season AGRI Kesähessu, 1 April to 30 September; all ex-VAT
markers.user_note: By default a contract runs 12 months and renews unless cancelled a month before the end; leaving mid-period costs €500, and fees already billed are not refunded. The two cheaper licences are described as suited to farming.

markers.name: Topnet Live
markers.yearly_cost: price on request
markers.user_note: Sold through resellers. The Finnish reseller describes one licence that switches between Topcon's regional networks, across countries too, and compatibility with any rover using network corrections.

markers.name: Umhvørvisstovan GNSS Network
markers.user_note: Access is arranged by contacting the agency, whose published offer addresses land-survey and construction firms; in 2020 it described the corrections as free. RINEX from the same bases requires a free Danish Dataforsyningen account.

markers.name: Actisat
markers.yearly_cost: price on request
markers.user_note: Subscriptions are arranged by telephone or e-mail. Its stations' observation files are free through IGN's RGP archive.

markers.name: IGN RGP-IP
markers.region: France and its overseas territories, plus CNES stations worldwide
markers.conditions_note: Free, but every stream needs credentials that IGN issues on request to rgpadmin@ign.fr. IGN's written grant is a convention with partner networks, which hand over their own stations' observations; it does not cover private individuals.
markers.user_note: Many positions in the caster's own table are wrong, some by tens of kilometres.
markers.datum_epoch: Metropolitan France: RGF93 v2b = ETRF2000, epoch 2019.0

creds.userNote: the username and password IGN issues

markers.name: IGN RGP archive
markers.user_note: Most stations are the paid networks' own antennas. Files are Hatanaka-compressed RINEX 2; hourly files appear 3 to 30 minutes after the hour, and only newer stations have 1 s files.

markers.name: Orphéon
markers.yearly_cost: €2,280/yr for one département, or €870 for 60 h over 12 months (FullGNSS, one dealer's list); €290/month or €45/day in the operator's shop; all ex-VAT
markers.user_note: The shop's terms reserve its day, month and hour products for professionals, and checkout asks for a company or organisation. Also sold under the HxGN SmartNet brand.
markers.datum_epoch: Mainland France: RGF93 v2b (ETRF2000, epoch 2019.0) in the operator's current FAQ answer, RGF93v2 (ETRF2000, epoch 2009.0) in older answers on the same page. Antilles: RRAF91.

markers.name: Satinfo
markers.yearly_cost: price on request; one dealer lists a prepaid hour package valid a year at €350, the hour count chosen at checkout, VAT basis not stated
markers.user_note: Access comes as prepaid hour packages to be used within a year, as week, month or unlimited subscriptions, or priced by area from 300 km² up.

markers.name: Teria
markers.yearly_cost: price on request
markers.user_note: Set up in 2006 by the Ordre des Géomètres-Experts, the French chartered land-surveyors' body.

markers.name: FUNDCORSRD
markers.yearly_cost: RD$1,000/month (~USD 195/year) plus a US$500 joining contribution, payable in pesos at the day's rate
markers.user_note: One membership covers one user and two devices at once. The sign-up form asks for a cédula (Dominican national ID).

markers.name: Geoscience Australia GNSS Data Centre
markers.user_note: Processed in a current global frame such as ITRF2020, positions sit about 2 m from PNG94, which PNG's maps and survey marks have carried since 1996; earthquakes moved the ground over 5 m in places, and velocity-model conversion grows harder.

markers.name: GALNET (Cartogalicia)
markers.yearly_cost: EUR 500/yr or EUR 60/month, both ex-VAT
markers.user_note: Sold by phone or e-mail, not online. The operator names GPS and GLONASS only. Its public real-time viewer did not respond in July or October 2026, so whether the network still runs is unconfirmed.

markers.name: CloudbaseRTK
markers.yearly_cost: £575/yr on the agriculture subscription or £750/yr on the construction one, both without a roaming SIM; a single day £15 or £20 respectively; VAT basis not stated

markers.name: CSEQ QNET
markers.region: 30 km around each of its bases in Great Britain
markers.yearly_cost: £120/yr per stream or £330 for three years, ex VAT; where no base exists yet, £450–500 one-off for a base station to host, which makes the host's stream free
markers.user_note: Hosting needs a wired internet connection, electricity and a clear view of the sky; the base stays CSEQ's property, and prolonged or frequent outages can lead to the host's free stream being withdrawn and passed to another host.

markers.name: OS Net
markers.yearly_cost: Leica SmartNet £1,560/yr for 480 hours, incl VAT; Point One Polaris True RTK from US$125/month; a Trimble VRS Now licence £700 ex VAT, term not stated by the retailer
markers.user_note: Ordnance Survey sells no corrections directly; each commercial partner sets its own price, terms and product name. Some of those products mix OS stations with the partner's own.
markers.datum_epoch: ETRS89 realised as EUREF IE/UK 2009 (parent ITRF97, epoch 2009.756)

markers.name: OS Net RINEX
markers.user_note: Data are sampled every 30 seconds; downloads need a free OS Data Hub account on the OpenData plan, and files stay on the portal for 45 days, older ones in separate long-term archives.
markers.datum_epoch: ETRS89 realised as EUREF IE/UK 2009 (parent ITRF97, epoch 2009.756)

markers.name: RTKFnet
markers.yearly_cost: £525/yr without a data SIM or £650 with one, ex VAT, on the agriculture and drone tariff; construction, survey, marine and other work £900/yr ex VAT
markers.user_note: The agriculture and drone rate has no online checkout and is sold by enquiry.

markers.name: GentooARS
markers.yearly_cost: 65,000 RSD/yr (~USD 610); 25,000 RSD/yr (~USD 235) for agricultural machinery; 12,000 RSD/month (~USD 115). VAT basis not stated
markers.user_note: Accounts are opened on request giving a company name; the terms set no professional condition, commit the operator to repairing a failed station within five days and renew yearly accounts unless cancelled.
markers.datum_epoch: RGZ's 2019 admission decision gives the first ten stations' positions in SRB_ETRS89 (ETRF2000, epoch 2010.63)

markers.name: GEO-CORS
markers.region: Georgia, except Abkhazia and South Ossetia
markers.user_note: The public shop doesn't say which package includes MAX, i-MAX and trimble_VRS: "Real Time Kinematic" reads single-base, "TRIM" reads "all products". Sign-up requires Company and Rover Brand, both free text. Only Nea_GAL lists Galileo.

markers.name: RED-GEO
markers.region: La Paz, Cochabamba, Oruro, Tarija, Ivirgarzama and the Santa Cruz area
markers.yearly_cost: price on request
markers.user_note: Switching between stations is reserved for annual subscribers.

markers.name: GEOCOM Red GNSS
markers.user_note: Neither GEOCOM's 2021 note on the network nor its online store offers a way to buy access. GEOCASTER, its 2025 service, is separate: the operator describes customers connecting their own base stations.

markers.name: GEOCUBA NTRIP
markers.user_note: Presented in 2024 as running over GEOCUBA corporate mobile SIM cards, for some priority sectors of the national economy.

markers.name: GeokursNET
markers.yearly_cost: 59,400 KZT/yr for 3 chosen stations (~USD 133); 64,900 KZT/yr for all stations (~USD 145); 6,600 KZT/month for 3 stations (~USD 15); incl. VAT, per receiver, third-party brands
markers.user_note: Each receiver is registered by brand, model, serial and label photo. The tariffs name six third-party brands; u-blox and Emlid are not among them.

markers.name: Geomatica CORS RD
markers.yearly_cost: price on request
markers.user_note: A 2025 presentation by the national geographic institute (IGN) describes a commercial service for customers with Trimble receivers; the company's own page names surveyors, GIS users, engineers and scientists as users.

markers.name: Geo+
markers.yearly_cost: from R$4,745/yr, i.e. R$13/day on the annual plan (~USD 887); day, week and month plans quoted on request
markers.user_note: Every plan, the annual one included, is sold by quote.

markers.name: GeoRED (Servicio Geológico Colombiano)
markers.user_note: Streams arrive through the SIRGAS working group's experimental caster in Ecuador, which states they are free for research, training and the GNSS community.

markers.name: GeoRTK
markers.user_note: Bases are volunteers' own, with no published requirement on their position accuracy. The operator may charge later, after at least a year's notice.

markers.name: Geosatelites
markers.user_note: The shared host and login are published on the operator's homepage and have changed before. The homepage lists nine stations; the caster carries eight.

markers.name: GeoTerrace (Lviv Polytechnic)
markers.yearly_cost: price on request
markers.user_note: Sign-up is free; each service, RINEX downloads included, is then provided only under a separate agreement.

markers.name: Trimnet VRS
markers.yearly_cost: price on request
markers.user_note: Licences run by the year, by the month or as time packages; quotes are addressed to organisations. Open to all receiver brands.
markers.datum_epoch: EUREF-FIN (ETRF96), epoch 1997.0; other coordinate systems offered

markers.name: Global GIS CORS Network
markers.yearly_cost: 300,000 LKR/year (~USD 906); 1 month 45,000 LKR (~USD 136); 1 day 2,000 LKR (~USD 6)

markers.name: Guyana Lands and Surveys Commission
markers.user_note: 2025 reporting frames the network around cadastral work. GLSC's listed survey services do not include it, and no host, terms, fee or sign-up for outside users is publicly known.

markers.name: GNET
markers.region: selected towns and settlements of Greenland
markers.user_note: Access is by e-mail to the Danish Agency for Climate Data; the service was announced for surveyors and contractors. Only encrypted NTRIP v2 over TLS connects. Greenland's official frame, GR96(2021), sits about 0.6 m from current global frames.

markers.name: GNET data archive
markers.user_note: Downloads need a free account. Most remote sites hand over their data only at a maintenance visit each August, so their files can be up to a year old.

markers.name: Rete GNSS Abruzzo + Lazio
markers.user_note: The operator's instructions page names a second caster address, 88.44.106.194; neither address answered connections from Switzerland in October or November 2026.

markers.name: Rete GNSS Campania
markers.user_note: The operator's access page also prints the hostname gps-sit.regione.campania.it, which resolves to a different address from 109.115.186.34, where the caster answers.

markers.name: Rete GNSS Liguria
markers.user_note: The Region's service pages name no fee and do not call the service free; the EU Copernicus in-situ provider register lists its GNSS data as free.

markers.name: GNSSnet.hu
markers.yearly_cost: 150,000 HUF/yr, 8 HUF/min single-base or 12 HUF/min network RTK, plus a one-off 12,000 HUF registration — all ex-VAT; ~USD 605/yr with 27% VAT
markers.user_note: Access needs a Hungarian-only paper contract: three signed copies posted to Budapest, switched on after legal review and counter-signing, in as little as five working days. Foreign buyers can take 10 days for 10,000 HUF without one, extendable twice.

markers.name: Red CORS del Instituto Geográfico Nacional
markers.user_note: Files are ordered by form for one date and one 12-hour window, at Q105 per 10 hours (~USD 14); IGN says before payment whether the data exist. Its own 2015 report counted 7 of the sites active.

markers.name: HaloRTK
markers.region: the Auckland region and Queenstown, with LINZ bases elsewhere
markers.yearly_cost: NZD 1,000/yr ex-GST (~USD 564); NZD 700 for 6 months ex-GST; NZD 150/month ex-GST; each for one approved connection
markers.user_note: A rover connects to one named base, whatever the site's “Network RTK” wording; 8 of the 17 are LINZ sites PositioNZ-RT streams free. Terms limit it to internal business use, and the site lists Topcon, Trimble and Leica as compatible.

markers.name: HEPOS
markers.yearly_cost: EUR 480/yr unlimited, ex-VAT; EUR 160 for 3 months; metered EUR 0.10/min plus EUR 10/month (2022 list) and a EUR 90 one-off registration, which may also apply to packages
markers.user_note: The national registry names individuals in Greece and abroad as eligible, but the 2021 paper form asks for a tax number and declared business address. The operator publishes the official transformation to the national grid ΕΓΣΑ87, with software.
markers.datum_epoch: HTRS07, the Greek realisation of ETRS89 (ETRF2005, epoch 2007.5)

markers.name: CORS Hi-Target Indonesia
markers.user_note: Stations drop off the caster and return; one that is off still accepts a connection and sends nothing. The operator's terms name no receiver brand. The caster lists hundreds of mounts worldwide, all at position 0,0 and without place names.

markers.name: VRS Systems PR (HLCM Group)
markers.yearly_cost: price on request
markers.user_note: Marketed to surveying, mapping, GIS, construction and agriculture professionals, with no individual plan advertised.

markers.name: Instituto Geográfico Nacional (IGN Honduras)
markers.user_note: The geodesy unit offers raw station data to "any national or foreign institution", naming no fee or way to request it.
markers.datum_epoch: ITRF2014, station coordinates at the epoch of measurement

markers.name: Hoda / Hoda Pro
markers.yearly_cost: price on request
markers.user_note: Sold from single-day to annual terms. Needs a national ID, and support confirms each account. The station count may include SHAMIM's stations.

markers.name: HOSAC FREE RTK
markers.user_note: The operator sells auto-steer hardware, but states the free service is open to anyone with an NTRIP-format receiver. Labelled a beta. Host, port and login are issued by email after registration rather than published.

markers.name: CROPOS
markers.user_note: Registering costs €40 once and takes a signed form in Croatian asking for an OIB, the Croatian ID number; acceptance without one is unstated. Port 2102's single-station mountpoints aren't in the published settings, so a login may not reach them.
markers.datum_epoch: ETRF2000(R05), measurement epoch 2008.83, which the operator treats as the national ETRS89 frame HTRS96 (epoch 1995.55). For rovers that apply RTCM 1021/1023, HTRS96-named mounts add HVRS71 heights; HDKS-named mounts give the legacy HDKS coordinate system (Bessel) with Trieste heights, _NW and _NE for those parts of Croatia.

markers.name: EarthScope Haiti stations (CN09, JME2)
markers.region: the Cap-Haïtien, Jacmel and Port-au-Prince areas
markers.user_note: Licensed CC BY 4.0, which allows commercial use. Downloads need a free EarthScope login.
markers.datum_epoch: IGS14 station coordinates, also published in NAM14, IGS08 and NAM08

markers.name: Huace FixCM (华测CORS)
markers.region: mainland China except Tibet and a few uninhabited areas
markers.yearly_cost: price on request
markers.user_note: The operator directs receivers of other brands to a reduced mount: 4 constellations and 11 frequencies instead of 5 and 16.
markers.datum_epoch: CGCS2000 on port 8001; WGS84 on port 8002, ITRF2014 (epoch written as 2020.10.1 by the operator) on port 8003

markers.name: HxGN SmartNet Greece
markers.yearly_cost: EUR 360/yr unlimited single-base, ex-VAT; EUR 720/yr unlimited network RTK; EUR 125/yr for 20 hours of network RTK
markers.user_note: There is no online checkout: a subscription is ordered from the operator, then activated Monday to Friday, 16:00–19:00. A seven-day trial licence is free.
markers.datum_epoch: HTRS07, matched to the national HEPOS network; mounts named NON_HEPOS_*_ITRF are labelled ITRF

markers.name: HxGN SmartNet Italy (ItalPoS)
markers.yearly_cost: €230/yr Nearest Unlimited (nearest-station corrections only); €350/yr or €90/month NRTK Unlimited; all ex-VAT
markers.user_note: In 2020 Regione Sardegna bought its own RTK corrections from this service. Constellations per tier are unclear: one reseller lists Galileo and BeiDou on network corrections only for Full GNSS (€385/yr ex-VAT).

markers.name: HxGN SmartNet North America
markers.yearly_cost: about USD 2,400/yr for one state
markers.user_note: Terms from one month to five years are priced only after registering an account. The operator's coverage map is a drawn area dated 2021, with no station locations.
markers.datum_epoch: NAD83(2011) epoch 2010.0; an alternate epoch in high-velocity areas such as California

markers.name: HxGN SmartNet Netherlands
markers.yearly_cost: €1,297/yr unlimited; €538/yr for 120 hours; €324/yr for 60 hours; reseller prices with no VAT label; mobile SIM not included

markers.name: ichimill (SoftBank)
markers.yearly_cost: ¥39,600/yr incl. VAT (~USD 265) as two ¥19,800 online terms; ¥3,000/month ex-VAT direct from SoftBank
markers.user_note: Sold to individuals online, in terms of six to seven months with no refund; continuing needs a new application and login. SoftBank's own route needs a company seal. Rated usable within 10 km of its nearest station, per its ALES calculator.

markers.name: InaCORS
markers.user_note: BIG, the national mapping agency, last called the service free around 2021. A 2024 finance regulation lets it charge, at a figure its head sets, down to zero. The caster flags every mount as fee-based. Sign-up requires a company and mobile number.
markers.datum_epoch: SRGI2013, semi-dynamic: InaCORS station coordinates on ITRF2014, epoch 2021.0, since 2025-02-25; on ITRF2008, epoch 2012.0, before that

creds.userNote: your portal login, or the NTRIP one you set at sign-up

markers.name: IDi-CORS
markers.yearly_cost: Q250/week (~USD 33), Q75/day (~USD 9.80), per station and rover, IVA included; listed as launch prices
markers.user_note: One NTRIP access per account at a time; another station or more rovers are arranged by e-mail.

markers.name: CSEQ QNET
markers.region: the area within about 30 km of Wexford
markers.yearly_cost: about €145/yr ex-VAT, the operator's £120 converted at its shop's rate
markers.user_note: The operator's coverage checker takes UK postcodes only, not Eircodes; its browser-location button answers for any position.

markers.name: JL Agnet
markers.yearly_cost: €650/yr or €400 for 6 months, ex-VAT
markers.user_note: Joining asks for an auto-steer system unlocked for RTK that accepts NTRIP, plus a modem holding the operator's multi-network SIM. The operator gives no base positions; a free three-day trial precedes subscription.

markers.name: Tailte Éireann / OSNI Active GNSS
markers.user_note: The archive holds only the last 30 days of data. Real-time corrections from the same stations are sold by commercial partners, such as Leica SmartNet.

markers.name: IGAC Red Geodésica Nacional
markers.user_note: New accounts need IGAC's manual approval; the required company field takes free text. In October 2026 mounts named CL_ streamed with no account, though IGAC documents account access only. A 2024 field test found network solutions unavailable.

markers.name: Instituto Geográfico y del Catastro Nacional
markers.user_note: USD 11.50 per request, made to the institute's sales department in San Salvador; each file covers 24 hours at 15-second intervals.

markers.name: IGN REGNA-RD
markers.user_note: Sign-up makes one of seven professional titles and an institution mandatory, and the IGN verifies the form before issuing credentials. The caster labels itself experimental. The licence requires citing the IGN in any publication or product.

markers.name: IGN REGNA-RD RINEX
markers.user_note: Daily RINEX 2 files at 15 s under provider FUNCORSRD, hourly RINEX 3 files at 1 s under TRIMBLERD and IGN-JJHM. Currency varies by station, with some archives weeks or months behind.

markers.name: IGNTG RGN-CORS
markers.user_note: Relayed by the SIRGAS working group's experimental caster in Ecuador. Sends GPS, GLONASS, Galileo and BeiDou although the caster lists it as GPS+GLONASS. The position it broadcasts sits 6.7 cm above IGNTG's published antenna reference point.

markers.name: IGNTG RGN-CORS
markers.user_note: Daily RINEX 2.11 files at 15 s with GPS and GLONASS, posted around 05:00 UTC the next day to a SharePoint folder needing no login.

markers.name: IGS-IP
markers.region: the areas around its stations, worldwide
markers.user_note: Registration asks for an organisation, offers Other as a type and states no eligibility rule. Some streams are listed without the message giving the base's coordinates, which a rover needs. Some appear available while silent, for weeks or longer.
markers.datum_epoch: Varies by stream: IGS guidelines encourage current IGS coordinates (IGc20, aligned to ITRF2020), not enforced; relayed streams carry what their source caster sends, e.g. ETRS89 (EUREF-IP), GDA2020 (Australian stations), SIRGAS2000 (IBGE), ITRF2014 (EarthScope).

markers.name: REMOS (IGVSB)
markers.user_note: A dealer advertised the pre-2014 network as free nationwide. IGVSB, re-establishing it since 2025, names geodesy, mapping, cadastre, climate monitoring and university research as its purposes and has published no access terms.
markers.datum_epoch: Station coordinates in ITRF2020 at the observation epoch (2026.525; MTRN 2025.759); legal frame SIRGAS-REGVEN (ITRF94 @ 1995.4)

markers.name: Andhra Pradesh State CORS
markers.user_note: Under an October 2025 agreement Survey of India is to operate and upgrade these stations for five years, with the state keeping the revenue. In January 2026 Survey of India named the state government as the contact for real-time use.

markers.name: Survey of India CORS
markers.region: India except Andhra Pradesh, Tamil Nadu, Puducherry, Bihar, parts of the North-East and some forest, border and island areas
markers.yearly_cost: ₹60,000/year (~USD 632); ₹15,000/3 months (~USD 158); ₹5,000/month (~USD 53) — all ex-GST
markers.user_note: Sign-up needs a Voter ID, Driving Licence, Aadhaar or PAN; a passport is not on the list. The fee is waived for government bodies and government academic institutions.

markers.name: Tamil Nadu State CORS
markers.user_note: In January 2026 Survey of India named the state government as operator and as the contact for real-time use.

markers.name: INETER (Instituto Nicaragüense de Estudios Territoriales)
markers.user_note: The CORS data service sits behind a form asking for a Nicaraguan identity card, residence card or passport number.

markers.name: ReNEP-CV
markers.yearly_cost: price on request
markers.user_note: The sign-up form requires a company name, though the terms set no professional condition. In October 2026 the caster listed only nearest-station mounts, although the terms also name network RTK.

markers.name: General Directorate for Survey (Iraq)
markers.user_note: Hosted by the US National Geodetic Survey rather than the operator; no account needed. Station IDs ISER and ISNA; daily RINEX 2 files, 5-second for 30 days, then 30-second.
markers.datum_epoch: ITRF2020 (2020.0) for both stations, as published by NGS. The national frame (IGRS) is ITRF2000 (1997.0, epoch per a 2022 paper)

markers.name: SHAMIM / SHAMIM Plus
markers.user_note: SHAMIM was cut for about a month from the June 2025 war and over 70 days from early 2026; more outages are blamed on GNSS jamming, internet and power cuts. The two systems have separate sign-ups, each with a national ID and land-registry approval.
markers.datum_epoch: Station coordinates in ITRF2014 and IRGD2010

markers.name: IceCORS
markers.user_note: Access is requested by e-mail, naming a company and contact; no licence, qualification or Icelandic identity number is asked for. RTCM30 auto-selects a station, which can be SENG or GEVK, so its epoch varies with rover position; VRS stays in ISN2016.
markers.datum_epoch: ISN2016 (IGS14, epoch 2016.5); Reykjanes base reference coordinates: SENG epoch 2023-11-29, GEVK epoch 2024-02-23, AUSV and VOGC ISN2016 ("special ISN2016" on the operator's diagram)

markers.name: İSKİ UKBS
markers.user_note: İSKİ describes the free access as temporary and for testing, and need not issue a login to every applicant. Its application form makes an institution or company name mandatory.

markers.name: IVI-net
markers.yearly_cost: UAH 1,500/month (~USD 33), no annual tier; UAH 200/day (~USD 4.40)
markers.user_note: Free periods for connecting, setting up and testing equipment are offered beside the tariffs; who qualifies is not stated.
markers.datum_epoch: ETRS89; mountpoints deliver SK-63, UCS-2000, oblast MSK and WGS 84 UTM grids

markers.name: gFIX.net (National Land Agency)
markers.user_note: GPS and GLONASS only. The network solution comes only as Trimble CMR+/CMRx or RTCM 2.3, which an RTCM-3-only rover cannot use; seven bases offer RTCM 3 single-base streams. The portal's login asks for an organisation.

markers.name: GFZ Helmholtz Centre for Geosciences
markers.user_note: No account needed; CC BY 4.0 with a citation requested. Station IDs BALJ00JOR and GHAJ00JOR; Hatanaka-compressed RINEX 3, in 30-second daily files and 1-second 15-minute files.

markers.name: Drogger Ntrip Caster
markers.user_note: Bases are customer-built. BizStation does not promise their positions match national coordinates, confirming that only for NEAR-TRUST bases and calling NEAR-FIXED accuracy unknown. The free experiment may turn paid, though not automatically.
markers.datum_epoch: Per base, self-declared in the caster's station list (JGD2024, JGD2011, 'current' and others); no network-wide frame.

markers.name: GEONET (GSI)
markers.yearly_cost: ¥198,000/yr incl. VAT (~USD 1,325) + ¥22,000 registration; ¥23,100/month; ¥7,700/day
markers.user_note: GSI runs no public caster, and its own distributor serves only businesses and research bodies; the real-time stream reaches individuals through resellers. Prices are Nippon GPS Data Service's, whose terms admit individuals.
markers.datum_epoch: JGD2024, horizontal values inherited from JGD2011: reference epoch 2011-05-24 in eastern prefectures (Aomori, Iwate, Miyagi and mainland Tokyo among them), 1997-01-01 elsewhere; heights 2024-06-01. Semi-dynamic correction to the observation epoch.

markers.name: GEONET RINEX (GSI)
markers.user_note: Free files are 30-second; GSI releases 1-second data only on application after large earthquakes. Accounts are deleted after two years without a login.
markers.datum_epoch: JGD2024, horizontal values inherited from JGD2011: reference epoch 2011-05-24 in eastern prefectures (Aomori, Iwate, Miyagi and mainland Tokyo among them), 1997-01-01 elsewhere; heights 2024-06-01. Semi-dynamic correction to the observation epoch.

markers.name: Khmer GEONET
markers.region: the Phnom Penh area, Siem Reap and Stung Treng
markers.conditions_note: Free during the operator's test phase. Earlier end dates were extended; the latest posted, 1 July 2026, has passed with no later date on its site. A 2024 operator draft proposes USD 500/year or USD 50/month, plus USD 50 registration.
markers.user_note: Accounts need operator approval, and the portal's self-registration page returned a "temporarily not available" error in October and November 2026.

markers.name: KollNET
markers.region: parts of Chile, from Calama to Coyhaique
markers.yearly_cost: CLP 535,500/yr (~USD 560); 1 month CLP 101,150 (~USD 106); 7 days CLP 57,120 (~USD 60)
markers.user_note: Ordered by contacting the seller, not through the shop page. The caster address comes with the credential, which serves one device at a time. VRS is described as an additional service, with no price stated.

markers.name: KOPOS
markers.yearly_cost: €400/yr, €250/6 mo, €60/mo; €20 one-off registration
markers.user_note: The sign-up form requires a company name, though the tariff applies to private persons as well as companies. RINEX data for post-processing is a separate subscription at €100/yr.

markers.name: KPLC CORS Services
markers.yearly_cost: KES 334,080/yr (~USD 2,570), KES 27,840/month (~USD 214), KES 232/hour (~USD 1.79) — per receiver, VAT included
markers.user_note: Sign-up asks for a company name but no licence or survey credential. M-Pesa is the only payment channel, and the phone field expects a +254 number. Hour and day blocks are valid for 30 days.

markers.name: GNSS Data Center
markers.user_note: Sign-up asks only for an e-mail and a password, on a Korean-only portal; its sign-up page says accounts are deleted after 50 days without a login. Mounts stay listed while the portal reports a station's connection as faulty.
markers.datum_epoch: Per agency; NGII stations KGD2002 (ITRF2000, epoch 2002.0)

creds.userNote: your registered e-mail; NGII accounts: ID@geodesy.ngii.go.kr

markers.name: NGII Network RTK (RTS1)
markers.user_note: Two-step sign-up: NGII membership with a Korean identity check, no foreigner route on the join page, then a correction account on geodesy.ngii.go.kr, also valid on RTS2 and the GNSS Data Center. One connection per account, several per membership.

markers.name: NGII Network RTK (RTS2)
markers.user_note: Same correction account as RTS1: NGII membership with a Korean identity check, no foreigner route on the join page. One connection per account.

markers.name: Seoul Network RTK
markers.user_note: The operator states no service area, nor which stations feed the VRS. VRS-RTCM32 carries GPS, GLONASS and Galileo, VRS-RTCM31 GPS alone: fewer systems than the caster's table lists.

markers.name: KSA-CORS (GEOSA)
markers.user_note: Despite the login's organisation name, GEOSA named individuals among its users in 2020. Each receiver needs its own account and e-mail address; the caster IP and port come by e-mail, and the FAQ's hostname had no DNS record on 16 Oct and 13 Nov 2026.

markers.name: Kuwait Municipality
markers.user_note: Station count, coverage and VRS service come from a 2016 paper, not from the operator.

markers.name: Cayman Lands & Survey CORS
markers.yearly_cost: price on request
markers.user_note: There is no online signup: a subscription is arranged with the Chief Surveyor, and the connection details are issued to subscribers rather than published. The department's priced Website Subscriptions cover map and registry data, not corrections.

markers.name: Cayman Lands & Survey RINEX
markers.user_note: Stations shared with the paid real-time service, published by NOAA's National Geodetic Survey, not Lands & Survey; downloads need no account. Daily files sampled every 1 or 15 s fall to 30 s after 30 days; NOAA's CLASS archive keeps the originals.
markers.datum_epoch: Station coordinates come in two realisations: NOAA publishes ITRF2020 at epoch 2020.0 with velocities, the operator CIGD11 (ITRF2005 at epoch 2011.0).

markers.name: Kyivstar mAgri.RTK
markers.yearly_cost: UAH 17,700/yr (~USD 393), UAH 12,500/yr from a reseller (~USD 277); UAH 450/day (~USD 10); UAH 2 for a 7-day Try&Buy
markers.user_note: Kyivstar's product page shows no station map or count; in 2024 a surveyors' forum post said a coverage map is available only from a Kyivstar representative.
markers.datum_epoch: Output chosen by mountpoint: UCS-2000 and local MSK, SK-63, UTM, WGS 84, ITRF2020

markers.name: KyrPOS
markers.yearly_cost: 23,214 KGS/yr per receiver (~USD 265); 3,180 KGS/month (~USD 36)
markers.user_note: Neither sign-up route asks for a professional qualification. The operator's price table lists a day rate; its service page requires a contract term of at least a month and prices the day differently.

markers.name: EFT GROUP
markers.yearly_cost: price on request
markers.user_note: The operator says raw data for post-processing is free to registered, activated users; its page does not link where to register.

markers.name: Ghana CORS Net
markers.user_note: Registration needs a professional surveyor's licence, and the data are licensed for cadastral and licence-authorised survey work. The portal sells files per job, not a live correction stream.

markers.name: LATNET
markers.yearly_cost: CAD 1,000/yr; CAD 100/month; tax not stated
markers.user_note: The account is reviewed before use: credentials arrive by e-mail within a business day rather than at checkout.
markers.datum_epoch: NAD83(CSRS) v6, with ITRF frames offered as an alternative

markers.name: LatPos
markers.user_note: Registration alone opens no stream: each ordered product is switched on by an administrator within three working days. GPS+GLONASS is the base product; BeiDou, Galileo and four-system streams are ordered separately. Terms bind use to Latvian land.
markers.datum_epoch: LKS-2020 (ETRS89, epoch 2020.28) from 1 October 2026; LKS-92 before

markers.name: LEB-CORS (Lebanese Army)
markers.yearly_cost: USD 200 for 1,000 hours, USD 130 for 500 hours; one-year subscription, six months at half price
markers.user_note: Applications are made in person, or through an authorised representative, at the army's Geographic Affairs directorate in Aaraya, with an ID card or civil-registry extract. No route is stated for foreign applicants.

markers.name: LitPOS
markers.user_note: Sign-up is through the state portal TPS Vartai behind e-government sign-in: bank, e-signature, or a foreigners' route the operator does not detail. Access within 5 working days. Per the operator, network logins from before July 2026 no longer work.

markers.name: CORSnet
markers.yearly_cost: price on request
markers.user_note: The licence grants use in the normal course of the subscriber's business, for surveying and related work; personal use is not addressed.

markers.name: SLCORSnet
markers.yearly_cost: 360,000 LKR/year per receiver (~USD 1,090); 30 days 30,000 LKR (~USD 91); 1 day 2,000 LKR (~USD 6)
markers.user_note: Payment is a cash deposit at the operator's bank, with the slip emailed or faxed in; an account activates about 28 hours after the payment is confirmed — the one-day pass included. In October 2026 the account application was unavailable.

markers.name: Liberia Land Authority CORS
markers.user_note: The Land Authority publishes no caster address, terms or price. A project contractor trained 25 staff and five private surveyors on its upkeep and GNSS equipment. In 2023 the Authority undertook to seek a maintenance budget from 2024.

markers.name: Longyearbyen lokalstyre
markers.user_note: Kartverket found this base's coordinates in good agreement with its own Longyearbyen base and expects positions from the two services to match.

markers.name: SPSLux
markers.user_note: The sign-up form marks company name and contact name as required; the operator's terms state no eligibility or commercial-use condition. The single-station _RAW mountpoints are raw data, which the access page says is requested by e-mail.

markers.name: Libya — no public RTK network
markers.user_note: As of 2026, rival governments in Tripoli and the east remained deadlocked after the 2021 elections were postponed. A national station network went to tender in 2010; the Survey Department's 2024 manual ties precise work to international stations.

markers.name: MOLDPOS
markers.yearly_cost: RTK 100 252 MDL/mo (~USD 14, 100 min); RTK 400 828 MDL/mo (~USD 47, 400 min); RTK PRO unlimited 2,208 MDL/mo (~USD 125)
markers.user_note: The login on the operator's site connects but gets no corrections. Contracts bind users to metrologically verified equipment and ask private persons for a Moldovan personal number (IDNP). ROMPOS relays five stations as single-base GPS+GLONASS mounts.

markers.name: MontePN
markers.region: Podgorica, with Budva and Berane advertised
markers.user_note: University of Donja Gorica research caster. It flags its mounts as fee-based, yet the university's pages show no price or terms and the sign-up form is gone. The team's address is gnssteam@udg.edu.me; whether it issues logins is unstated.

markers.name: MontePN RINEX (EUREF station DGOR)
markers.user_note: Only 30-second daily files are published, no hourly and no high-rate, so a session waits for its UTC day to close.

markers.name: MontePos
markers.yearly_cost: €1,000/yr; €250/month; €100/24 h, all per receiver
markers.user_note: GPS and GLONASS only as of 2022. The application form asks for a company name, registration and tax numbers and a stamp; acceptance without them is unstated. The caster address and login come only after payment to a Montenegrin giro account.
markers.datum_epoch: ITRS on the GRS80 ellipsoid — the national system defined by the survey and cadastre law, realised by the CGREF network together with MontePos

markers.name: Metro Vancouver GNSS Service
markers.yearly_cost: CAD 3,300/yr incl. tax; CAD 340/month incl. tax
markers.user_note: Open to the public, but there is no online checkout: a PDF order form goes by post with a cheque or payment confirmation. Users must be named and be the subscriber's employees, one connection at a time.

markers.name: Metta CORS
markers.yearly_cost: USD 300/yr, USD 30/mo, USD 1,200/5yr
markers.user_note: A subscription also includes the base's raw observations (UBX or RINEX) for post-processing, downloadable in spans of up to three hours.

markers.name: TERIA
markers.yearly_cost: price on request
markers.user_note: The quote form asks for a company name and a business sector.

markers.name: IGN RGP archive
markers.region: Saint Martin, French and Dutch sides
markers.user_note: Station STMT, TERIA's antenna. Licence Ouverte permits commercial use; hourly 1 s files as well as daily 30 s. Files arrived on 94 of the first 287 days of 2026, none from 10 September to 14 October; missed days have not been back-filled.

markers.name: MI-GLIS
markers.yearly_cost: USD 3,300/yr for one device and 65 login hours a month on a 12-month contract, extra hours USD 10; USD 300/month on the shortest, 3-month term; surveyors USD 1,650/yr
markers.user_note: The draft contract is for business use, auto-renews and has no mid-term exit. The application form has a natural-person block but requires a company signatory, and the documents do not say whether private individuals are accepted.

markers.name: MI-GLIS RINEX (NOAA CORS archive)
markers.user_note: Files carry GPS and GLONASS only, no Galileo or BeiDou. After 30 days daily files drop from 1-second to 30-second. MI-GLIS sells raw data from its other stations at USD 20/h (surveyors USD 10/h).

markers.name: MIRAI / Go!GNSS
markers.region: around 40 countries worldwide, most of the stations in Australia and New Zealand, elsewhere a few per country
markers.user_note: Streams carry no base position message, so each station's coordinates must come from elsewhere. Sign-up is two accounts, Go!GNSS then Ntrip; accounts are deleted after 365 days without use. Crediting the data's source is required.

markers.name: MAKPOS
markers.yearly_cost: 54,300 MKD/yr for a first receiver (~USD 1,005), 7,008 MKD/month, 15 MKD/minute under the 2020 tariff, since replaced
markers.user_note: The cadastre agency's statement on its February 2024 tariff change reads either as a price cut or as MAKPOS becoming free. The 2018 self-registration form had a mandatory company field.
markers.datum_epoch: Reference stations determined in ETRS89 as ETRF2000, epoch 2010.631; the MKD_GRID and MKD_GRID_QGEO products instead output the national state coordinate system, MKD_GRID_QGEO with MK_HREF2022 quasi-geoid heights

markers.name: National GNSS CORS Network
markers.user_note: Test operation began in June 2025, with users from other ministry projects. The ministry publishes no caster address, terms or price; in June 2026 it sought a consultant to design pricing and governance.

markers.name: Survey Department reference network
markers.region: Nay Pyi Taw and Pyin Oo Lwin
markers.user_note: In 2020 the department told the UN it would like to share the stations' data once their administration and data management were in place; no later statement on outside access has been published.

markers.name: MonPOS
markers.user_note: MGL_network refuses rovers over about 35 km from a station; station mountpoints have no such limit. Nearly all streams carry GPS and GLONASS only, including those the caster lists as GNSS. Mountpoint names are unstable: an _02 suffix comes and goes.
markers.datum_epoch: CORS coordinates for national surveying and mapping: ITRF2020, epoch 2015.0 (agency order А/249). Legacy national datum: MONREF97, ITRF2000, epoch 1997.8.

markers.name: Ville de Montréal RTK network
markers.user_note: Used by the city's own crews, with no outside subscription or price published. Observation files from the seven city-owned stations are free in the federal archive.

markers.name: MoSRef
markers.conditions_note: Free once the operator approves an application. The form is built for an organisation: its name, its head's signature and stamp, and each receiver and antenna by serial number. The user guide and form do not say whether a private person qualifies.
markers.user_note: A portal account alone gives the last 90 days of RINEX and static post-processing, not live corrections. Approval lapses after a year. The operator lists BeiDou on the MSM5 mounts only; the FKP mount is legacy RTCM 2.x.
markers.datum_epoch: Station coordinates in ITRF2005, tied at epoch 2008.37568

markers.name: National Park Service GNSS
markers.user_note: Hourly 1-second files need no account. Live corrections from this station need an account: self-registration is switched off, accounts are created on e-mail request, and the portal does not say who qualifies.

markers.name: Réseau géodésique du Québec
markers.user_note: Québec's natural resources ministry reports latency on the server behind both streams, and connection attempts do not always succeed.

markers.name: Réseau géodésique du Québec — TCP stations
markers.user_note: Each base sends raw RTCM 3.2 on its own port of one ministry server, with no NTRIP mountpoint: a rover needs a TCP-client mode, or software that relays the stream as NTRIP.

markers.name: Muya CORS
markers.yearly_cost: KES 20,000/month (~USD 154), KES 4,000/day (~USD 31), KES 200/hour in 2–8 h blocks (~USD 1.54) — per device, VAT included, last published 2025
markers.user_note: Current rates sit behind the client login. Hour and day blocks are valid for 30 days. The terms license use "in the normal course of your business" under a one-year auto-renewing agreement, though Individual accounts and short blocks are offered.
markers.datum_epoch: ITRF2014 at the current observation epoch

markers.name: GeoCORS
markers.region: western and central Mexico, plus scattered cities elsewhere
markers.yearly_cost: MXN 13,920/yr incl IVA (~USD 740), MXN 1,392/30 days, MXN 232/day
markers.user_note: Registering takes a WhatsApp number; licence and connection details arrive there. A free 7-day demo licence is offered.

markers.name: INEGI RGNA
markers.user_note: INEGI publishes RINEX files only, despite some online guides naming a caster; no account is needed. Per INEGI, surveys tied to MEXI or COL2 after the 2010 and 2022 earthquakes drop to sub-metre precision under conventional processing.

markers.name: Red CORS México
markers.region: cities in every Mexican state except Morelos and Tlaxcala
markers.yearly_cost: MXN 20,416/yr (~USD 1,085) or MXN 2,041.60/mo for most rover brands; MXN 15,312/yr for Hi-Target or GeoMax rovers; IVA not stated
markers.user_note: Several dealers resell the same network, so it turns up under many sellers' names in searches. The free 7-day trial asks for serial-number photos of receiver and data collector. Anyone with a compatible receiver can request RINEX, member or not.

markers.name: MyRTKnet
markers.yearly_cost: RM 1,000/year (~USD 246)
markers.user_note: One login drives one receiver at a time; each renewal is a fresh application, not an extension. Post-processed RINEX is priced apart from the subscription, at RM 1 a minute for a virtual station or RM 2 an hour for a reference station.

markers.name: mynet.
markers.yearly_cost: €850/yr ex-VAT (~€1,054 incl. 24% VAT)
markers.user_note: The order e-mail template asks for a company name and registry code; it shows no option for private customers.

markers.name: Directorate of Survey and Mapping
markers.user_note: In May 2025 its ministry reported engaging consultants to bring the stations into service.

markers.name: New Brunswick Active Control System
markers.user_note: Service New Brunswick redistributes the files free of charge, as RINEX 2 at 30-second intervals, and keeps them online for six months.

markers.name: Qazgeodesy (NCGPI)
markers.yearly_cost: price on request
markers.user_note: The tariff table shows only after sign-in, and sign-up takes a Kazakh tax number, personal or company. A subscription is priced by how many reference stations it includes and how many rovers connect.

markers.name: NIGNET (OSGOF)
markers.user_note: The account form asks for no licence, but accounts need activation and the portal gives no price or terms. The caster last answered in July 2026.

markers.name: OTIC CORS Network
markers.yearly_cost: ₦1,000 per day (~USD 0.74); prepaid data ₦15,000 per 50 MB (~USD 11) or ₦150,000 per 1 GB (~USD 111), kept until used
markers.user_note: Sign-up needs a Nigerian National Identification Number (NIN), checked with NIMC. New accounts get 100 MB of correction data free. The portal publishes no station list.

markers.name: 06-GPS
markers.yearly_cost: €1,500/yr ex-VAT; €150/month ex-VAT; €1.00 per connected minute ex-VAT with no subscription
markers.user_note: Sign-up and trial forms both make a company or organisation name mandatory. A one-month trial is free, once. Its MoveRTK brand (€550/yr ex-VAT) is the machine-guidance channel, whose terms exclude ordinary RTK rovers and setting out.

markers.name: AGRS.NL
markers.user_note: Observations are not corrected for the offset between antenna reference point and phase centre, so the wrong antenna model for the station can shift positions, mainly in height. Mountpoints ending …NLD1 carry receiver-native raw data, not RTCM.
markers.datum_epoch: AGRS.NL stations: ETRF2000(R05) @ 2010.5, the AGRS2010 realisation of ETRS89, with new or changed stations computed at another epoch and tied in; North Sea stations: ETRF2000

creds.userNote: optional: your e-mail address, for notice of changes and major outages

markers.name: Kadaster GNSS data centre
markers.user_note: Files download without an account, including those of the stations that stream live only for a fee. Hourly 30-second files and 15-minute 1-second files arrive the same day, daily files the next.

markers.name: LNR Net
markers.yearly_cost: €1,500/yr, €200/month or €50/day; months and days are billed only for the periods actually used
markers.user_note: A free 30-day demo account comes through a form that requires a company name.

markers.name: NETPOS
markers.user_note: Network RTK serves only Kadaster, Rijkswaterstaat and their contractors. Single-station real-time streams sell at €475 per station a year; the form needs a Dutch business login, and non-business or foreign applicants go through a contact form.

markers.name: RTK-GPS.nl
markers.yearly_cost: €225/yr ex-VAT including a KPN SIM; €205/yr ex-VAT without a SIM; each further system €195 with SIM, €175 without
markers.user_note: Its compatibility list names farm-machinery systems only, and buyers of anything else are asked to make contact before ordering.

markers.name: RTKned
markers.user_note: Its terms supply the service only for machine guidance in farming, road building and earthmoving, and rule out survey work, ordinary RTK rovers, and setting out and measuring up.

markers.name: NLSC e-GNSS
markers.yearly_cost: NT$300 per account per day (~USD 9); NT$2,000 member permit per five years (~USD 61)
markers.user_note: Membership is limited to government bodies, schools and legal persons registered in Taiwan; applications without an agency seal or company chops are refused, and companies attach proof of registration.
markers.datum_epoch: By mountpoint: NLSC's own e-GNSS frame, realigned about every two years (e-GNSS[2025] since May 2025), or TWD97[2020] (2020.0), TWD97[2010] or TWD97 on the main island; TWD97[1997] on the Penghu, Kinmen and Matsu mountpoints.

markers.name: CPOS
markers.yearly_cost: NOK 11,000 standard; NOK 8,000 receiver fixed in a machine, boat or drone; NOK 5,000 agriculture — per year ex-VAT (~USD 1,180 / 860 / 540)
markers.user_note: The order form requires a company name, and from new customers a corporate registration number, trial included. Free on application for thesis work and pre-commercial start-ups. HxGN SmartNet, Trimble VRS Now and Blinken run on these stations' data.
markers.datum_epoch: EUREF89 (Norway's ETRS89 realisation), ~epoch 1989.0; ellipsoidal heights referred to 1995.0; vertical NN1954/NN2000

markers.name: CPOS Svalbard
markers.yearly_cost: price on request
markers.user_note: Kartverket's CPOS guide gives the service's coverage as mainland Norway. GPS and GLONASS only.
markers.datum_epoch: EUREF89 in its 2009–10 Svalbard readjustment ("nytt EUREF89")

markers.name: NOANET (National Observatory of Athens)
markers.region: Greece, mainly the south and west; no NOANET station in Macedonia or Thrace
markers.user_note: Downloads are anonymous; the operator asks that any use carry its published citations. The archive holds daily 30-second files, with other sampling intervals supplied on request. Not every listed station is running, and some deliver GPS only.

markers.name: EarthScope Chitwan station (CHWN)
markers.user_note: The station records at 15-second intervals, not 1 Hz. EarthScope's own archive needs a free account.

markers.name: Survey Department — RTK Correction Services
markers.region: an area the department has not published
markers.yearly_cost: NPR 96,000/year (~USD 620); NPR 27,000/3 months (~USD 174); NPR 10,000/month (~USD 65)
markers.user_note: In 2025 the department's staff wrote that its planned network of about 30 reference stations was still being built. Individuals need a copy of a Nepali citizenship certificate; foreign applicants may need Survey/Mapping Committee approval.

markers.name: Canadian Active Control System
