markers.user_note: Downloads need a free account.
markers.datum_epoch: NAD83(CSRS) epoch 2010.0 on the station reports, with ITRF realisations selectable per station

markers.name: Nova Scotia Active Control Stations
markers.yearly_cost: price on request
markers.user_note: The province sells no subscription itself: the real-time stream reaches a buyer only through survey-dealer resellers. Observation files from the same stations are free through the federal archive.

markers.name: AllDayRTK
markers.yearly_cost: price on request
markers.user_note: About half its stations are LINZ-sourced, free via PositioNZ-RT. Sold as “Network RTK”; its public mountpoints are all single-base. Licence: per device, for business use in surveying and related work; auto-renews. Self-service 30-day free trial.

markers.name: GeoNet GNSS archive
markers.user_note: 30-second daily and hourly files download without an account. 1-second files are kept for two months, for PositioNZ sites only.

markers.name: OmanCORSnet
markers.user_note: NSGIA's public pages name no price, nor call the service free. Royal Decree 43/2026 requires prior NSGIA approval for terrestrial surveys, leaving what counts as one to executive regulations. Mounts list GPS and GLONASS only.
markers.datum_epoch: ONGD23 (ITRF2020 @ 2023.0, plate-fixed) and PSD93 (Clarke 1880) on the mounts so named. For the other mounts, a 2026 paper by users of the network gives ONGD17 (ITRF2014 @ 2017.0); ArduSimple gives ONGD23.

markers.name: OTC (Office de la Topographie et du Cadastre)
markers.yearly_cost: 6,000 TND/yr (~USD 2,050); 840 TND/30 days (~USD 287); 60 TND/day (~USD 21), all ex-VAT
markers.user_note: Listed users are OTC offices, private surveyors and public bodies; individuals are neither listed nor excluded, and the form asks for a tax number. Official maps use the national NTT grid; OTC's NTT page prints no conversion parameters.

markers.name: Pegaso VRS Now
markers.region: All of Italy, including the islands
markers.yearly_cost: €449/yr network RTK; €499/yr with 1 s RINEX; €365/yr post-processing only; VAT basis not stated
markers.user_note: Run by Trimble in partnership with Difesa Servizi; the Istituto Geografico Militare, the national mapping agency, computes, tests and monitors the stations.

markers.name: Prince Edward Island Active Control Network
markers.yearly_cost: price on request
markers.user_note: The province owns the stations; SmartNet runs the network and sells the subscriptions.

markers.name: AllDayRTK
markers.yearly_cost: From AUD 400 + GST per vehicle per year (AUD 440 incl GST, ~USD 300), a reseller's price for the Australian National subscription; Aptella's pages give no rates. 30-day free trial.
markers.user_note: Aptella sells AllDayRTK for Australia and New Zealand. None of its published casters lists a mount for this base, and Aptella's pages do not say whether a subscription serves a rover in Lae.

markers.name: PAGeNet
markers.yearly_cost: PHP 12,000/month (~USD 188); PHP 100/hour per station per rover (~USD 1.57); PHP 1,000 one-time registration (~USD 16)
markers.user_note: Sign-up needs a signed order slip and agreement, notarised above PHP 10,000; Metro Manila clients pay in person at NAMRIA in Taguig, others by LandBank deposit. Registered users get 30–60 s observation files for post-processing free.
markers.datum_epoch: PGD2020 (ITRF2014, epoch 2020.044) on mountpoints prefixed PGD2020_; the others carry WGS84 as NAMRIA's 2010 adjustment or the original 1987 WGS84

markers.name: Pivotpos
markers.yearly_cost: 900 RON/yr, 50 RON/7 days or 15 RON for one day with 6 h of use (~USD 187/yr)
markers.user_note: Its website names no reference frame for the corrections.

markers.name: SUPARCO Pak-GBAS / Pak-Rehber
markers.region: Karachi and about 20 km around it
markers.yearly_cost: price on request
markers.user_note: Sold through SUPARCO's commercial arm to users SUPARCO authorises, on terms it does not publish. Third-party receivers get GPS and GLONASS corrections only.

markers.name: PositioNZ-RT
markers.user_note: LINZ recommends staying within 15 km of the connected station. Some stations are run by other suppliers on a best-endeavours basis, and some GeoNet stations may stream only GPS or GPS/GLONASS.

markers.name: NOAA CORS Network
markers.user_note: NAD83(2011) is fixed to the North American plate, which Puerto Rico is not on, so a point's epoch-2010.00 coordinates and its 2026 position in that frame are about 0.3 m apart, growing by 17–18 mm a year.

markers.name: PrinNet
markers.yearly_cost: RUB 48,800/yr (~USD 588); 1 month RUB 4,880; 1 day RUB 366
markers.user_note: A new registration gets five days of full access free.

markers.name: Red Sísmica de Puerto Rico (Puerto Rico Seismic Network)
markers.user_note: No caster address is published: host and port are issued on e-mail request, and the address the operator's site links did not resolve in July or October 2026. Which of its stations are streaming is not published.

markers.name: Palestine — no Palestinian RTK network
markers.user_note: The Palestinian Land Authority's national survey reference, launched in 2025, is built on points measured in survey campaigns, and Israeli networks publish no sign-up route for Palestinian residents.

markers.name: QCORS (Centre for GIS)
markers.conditions_note: Government bodies (with an official letter) and companies (with their commercial registration) may subscribe. The terms, dating from 2016–2021, charge no fee.
markers.user_note: CGIS describes its corrections as GPS and GLONASS.

markers.name: Qianxun FindCM (千寻知寸)
markers.yearly_cost: CNY 3,600/yr (~USD 500); CNY 400/month, reseller prices
markers.user_note: Reseller terms allow access only directly over a mobile network. Direct sign-up has asked for a real name and national ID number; resellers also sell to individuals.

markers.name: RAK-CORS (Ras Al Khaimah Municipality)
markers.region: the Emirate of Ras Al Khaimah
markers.yearly_cost: AED 5,000 per user; AED 7,500 per user with MSL heights (~USD 1,360 / 2,040)
markers.user_note: The application form lets individuals apply as well as companies. Each subscription is bound to the receiver serial numbers and the area declared on the form, and is non-refundable.

markers.name: RAMSAC-NTRIP
markers.user_note: Connections are capped at 8 hours each, with up to 3 running simultaneously per account.

markers.name: RAMSAC RINEX (IGN Argentina)
markers.user_note: PY01's receiver tracks GPS and GLONASS only. IGN's terms allow commercial use only where the data feeds a new derived product.

markers.name: RBMC-IP
markers.user_note: Each user may access only five stations. Sign-up needs a gov.br account, which is tied to a CPF (Brazilian taxpayer number); foreigners can obtain a CPF at a Brazilian consulate. Fewer stations stream on a given day than are declared.

markers.name: REGME-IP
markers.user_note: Only Quininde-QNEC-IGM carries Galileo and BeiDou; the other live mounts are GPS and GLONASS only. Mount names on IGM's station list fail; repeated failures ban the IP for a while. IGM's licence text still states ITRF2008 epoch 2016.4.

markers.name: REGME RINEX (Descargas IGM)
markers.user_note: Needs a free account, with five downloads a day. Data appear three working days later: 1-second raw files, 30-second RINEX 2.11. IGM's manual limits downloads to IGM-owned stations; the current list shows only after sign-in.

markers.name: REGNA-ROU (Instituto Geográfico Militar)
markers.user_note: Each account gets one real-time connection; IGM considers more on justified request. Sign-up has a mandatory company field; the terms set no professional condition. Mounts with MSM in the name add Galileo and, on most, BeiDou to GPS and GLONASS.

creds.userNote: your NTRIP user name, or your SBC user name if none was set

markers.name: REGPMOC (Instituto Geográfico Nacional del Perú)
markers.yearly_cost: price on request
markers.user_note: IGN e-mails the caster address and login after payment. In 2022 it counted 52 of REGPMOC's then 73 stations as able to serve real-time corrections.

markers.name: REGPMOC VRS (Instituto Geográfico Nacional del Perú)
markers.yearly_cost: price on request

markers.name: ReIL-NET
markers.yearly_cost: USD 1,575/year or USD 200/month, ex sales tax

markers.name: Re.M.FVG "Antonio Marussi"
markers.user_note: The terms of use state that the stream "cannot be utilised for implementing paid services".

markers.name: ReNEP
markers.region: mainland Portugal, Madeira island, and São Miguel, Terceira and Flores in the Azores
markers.user_note: DGT reviews each sign-up and e-mails the user name and password once it accepts the user. Port 2101 station mounts, ACRT, NSRT and NSRT23 send GPS and GLONASS only; port 2102's add Galileo, most also BeiDou; ACR5 and NSR5 carry all four.
markers.datum_epoch: ETRS89 realised as ETRF97, epoch 1995.4, on the mainland; ITRF93, epoch 1994.0, in the Azores and Madeira

markers.name: Red de Estaciones Permanentes de Canarias (GRAFCAN)
markers.yearly_cost: EUR 180/yr per receiver (January 2015 price list; tax not stated)
markers.user_note: The shop section GRAFCAN points buyers to did not list the connection in October 2026. The shop licence bars commercial use without saying if that covers GNSS. The network's RINEX files are free.

markers.name: REPGRAM
markers.user_note: Its public pages gave no caster address or port in October 2026; the operator offers technical support for joining and setting up equipment. An account with no activity for six months or more can be suspended after notice.

markers.name: REPRAA
markers.user_note: The Azores regional government's permanent GNSS stations; site logs record receiver replacements in 2026. Its portal, repraa.azores.gov.pt, had no DNS record in October 2026, and its archived pages state no price or free use.

markers.name: Reutra
markers.yearly_cost: CHF 350/yr for the 1st licence, CHF 250 for a 2nd, CHF 150 for each further — all ex-VAT
markers.user_note: Marketed for farm steering and excavator control, with no buyer condition stated. Reutra publishes no station list, coverage map or caster details, nor whether it is network RTK or single-base. A free compatibility test licence is offered.

markers.name: RGAC (Red Activa de Estaciones GNSS de Cantabria)
RGAPA (Red GNSS Activa del Principado de Asturias)
markers.user_note: The caster stopped responding in September 2026 and the operator's website was unreachable in October 2026; the cause is not known.

markers.name: Rwanda Geodetic Network
markers.yearly_cost: price on request
markers.user_note: The land authority creates accounts itself; no sign-up form or caster address is published. Its explainer page calls the data free; its 2025 manual says subscriptions are paid. A lightning strike took one station down for about two months in 2025.

markers.name: Red de Apoyo Catastral Activa (RIC)
markers.user_note: Observation files are sold at Q10 (~USD 1.30) an hour, against a Guatemalan identity card (DPI) and the code of a property in a municipality under cadastral process.

markers.name: RING — Rete Integrata Nazionale GNSS (INGV)
markers.region: Italy and San Marino, with some stations in Greece and Malta
markers.user_note: INGV's RING page offers the data to "the entire scientific community" without naming a licence.

markers.name: ROB Belgian GNSS data repository
markers.user_note: Files download without an account. Most of its stations are FLEPOS stations, whose data FLEPOS itself releases only to registered organisations. Files are daily, at 30-second sampling.

markers.name: ROMPOS
markers.yearly_cost: 1,000 RON/yr or 100 RON/month per device, VAT incl. (~USD 207/yr, ~USD 21/month)
markers.user_note: New users open the account sign-up requires on ANCPI's ePay platform, offline in October and November 2026 after a July ransomware attack; a new payment module was announced without a date. ANCPI also lists an in-person desk in Bucharest.

markers.name: ROMPOS RINEX (EUREF stations)
markers.region: Baia Mare, Constanța, Deva, Focșani and Târgu Mureș
markers.user_note: Files at 30-second sampling, daily and hourly, from the EUREF Permanent Network's data centres with no account; ANCPI sells RINEX from every ROMPOS station at 15 RON an hour, VAT incl.

markers.name: RTK2go
markers.region: the areas around volunteer-run bases, worldwide
markers.user_note: Base positions are self-declared and unchecked, so rover positions can be metres off in absolute terms and neighbouring bases can disagree. A client that keeps retrying a dead mountpoint has its address blocked for hours.

markers.name: RTK.ie
markers.yearly_cost: €590/yr for 60 hours, €1,390/yr for 600 hours or €2,000/yr unlimited; €120 for 14 days unlimited; product pages say tax included, the terms of service say ex-VAT
markers.user_note: Hours count connected time only and lapse at the end of the term. A free trial exists, arranged through a demo request rather than the self-service checkout the paid tiers use.

markers.name: RTKHUB (TNT TPI)
markers.yearly_cost: UAH 10,500/yr (~USD 233); UAH 1,800 per 30 days (~USD 40); UAH 2.50/min in prepaid packs from 120 minutes (~USD 0.06)
markers.user_note: A private person's contract requires copies of a passport and of the Ukrainian tax number (ІПН), plus bank details.

markers.name: RTKmindenkinek
markers.yearly_cost: 59,990 HUF/yr ex-VAT with data SIM (~USD 242 with 27% VAT); first period prorated: 49,990 HUF from April, 29,990 from July, 19,990 from October
markers.user_note: Sold only with a multi-network data SIM, and every subscription ends on 31 December. The seller calls it brand-independent, naming tractor makes, but requires a SIM-card modem: UHF radio is not enough. It publishes a station count but no positions.

markers.name: RTKNet
markers.yearly_cost: RUB 30,000/yr (~USD 362); 1 month RUB 4,000; 1 day RUB 400
markers.user_note: A three-day free test is at the sales team's discretion: it follows a completed questionnaire and may be refused without a reason given.
markers.datum_epoch: ITRF2014 (2010.0) on the district ports 6030 to 6042; the older ports 6060 and 6061 keep the earlier coordinates

markers.name: Roscadastre (ССТП)
markers.region: central Russia, the Volga and Black Earth regions, Kuban, the North Caucasus, Perm, Orenburg, Chelyabinsk and Khabarovsk
markers.yearly_cost: RUB 28,000/yr (~USD 337), RUB 18,000/yr capped at 600 h; nearest-station only RUB 15,000/yr; 1 month RUB 3,500
markers.user_note: Payment is by invoice and bank transfer, from a company or registered sole trader only. The caster lists GPS and GLONASS only.
markers.datum_epoch: ITRF2008; the operator's transformation keys give coordinates in each region's local cadastral grid (MSK)

markers.name: SAPOS Brandenburg
markers.user_note: The operator offers the service for use in Brandenburg and up to 100 km around it.

markers.name: SAPOS Baden-Württemberg
markers.user_note: A one-time administrative fee of €150 (incl. VAT) applies per access credential issued. The operator advises against use outside Baden-Württemberg and reserves the right to block it.

markers.name: SAPOS Bayern
markers.yearly_cost: €20/yr flat per account (covers real-time RTK and post-processing data)

markers.name: SAPOS Mecklenburg-Vorpommern
markers.user_note: A one-time €100 administrative fee is charged per user at registration. The operator assigns each account to one of the two real-time services — Open RTK (openrtk mounts) or the surveying service HEPS (VRS mounts), not both.

markers.name: SAPOS Niedersachsen + Bremen
markers.user_note: The operator does not permit use outside Niedersachsen and Bremen.

markers.name: SAPOS Rheinland-Pfalz
markers.yearly_cost: €120/yr per account + €100 one-time setup; through Zentrale Stelle SAPOS €10/month + €100 one-time, ex-VAT
markers.user_note: Accounts can be closed only at 31 December, with the rest of the year's fee still due. Zentrale Stelle SAPOS, the German states' joint access service, reaches the same stations on a monthly term.

markers.name: SAPOS Thüringen
markers.user_note: Corrections are released only to rovers reporting a position inside Thüringen.

markers.name: SARNET
markers.yearly_cost: €250/yr ex-VAT per receiver (~€305 incl. VAT)
markers.user_note: The published tariff is dated 2009 and the station count June 2008; the access address linked from sarnet.it did not answer from Switzerland in October or November 2026.

markers.name: SatRef Network RTK
markers.user_note: Accounts unused for 12 months are terminated without notice. Only VRS32G carries Galileo and BeiDou; FKP23 is GPS-only RTCM 2.3. VRS32G and VRS_1023 broadcast the HK1980 transformation with geoid correction.

markers.name: Sudan — no public RTK network
markers.user_note: In 2022 the Sudan Survey Authority was at the planning stage for a permanent-station network. War between the Sudanese Armed Forces and the Rapid Support Forces began in April 2023 and was still being fought in mid-2026.

markers.name: SENCORS
markers.yearly_cost: 400,000 per 90 days, the portal's only plan — printed with no currency, and the page has also shown 0; read as CFA francs that is ~USD 680, or ~USD 2,700/yr
markers.user_note: The sign-up form requires a company name but no licence, ID or surveying credentials. Disk failures took the network out of service in January 2026; it was announced fully back on 16 March 2026, with a second control centre added.

markers.name: SiReNT
markers.yearly_cost: S$107.00/month per account incl. GST (~USD 83); S$32.10 one-time admin fee; free 3-day trial, one per month
markers.user_note: Sign-up is only through Singpass (citizens, permanent residents, pass holders) or Corppass (Singapore-registered entities). The terms limit use to the purpose stated on the application and rule out 'any commercial use whatsoever' without defining it.

markers.name: SDGS Kuzbass (Kemerovo State University)
markers.yearly_cost: RUB 27,000/yr (~USD 325); 1 month RUB 2,400; 1 day RUB 200; RTK and RINEX for one receiver
markers.datum_epoch: GSK-2011; also SK-95, SK-42 and the regional MSK-42 grid

markers.name: SIGNAL
markers.yearly_cost: €829.44/yr per GNSS device; €0.12/min while connected; post-processing files €0.26 per second of server conversion, about €4.21 per station-hour; all ex-VAT
markers.user_note: The free "non-commercial" package covers only public bodies, students for study work and societies with public-interest status, on proof the operator checks. Every contract, free or paid, is signed on paper and posted in four copies.
markers.datum_epoch: ETRS89 / D96-17: D96 (ETRF96, 1995.55) fitted by rigid transformation to D17 (ETRF2000, 2016.75)

markers.name: SIRGAS-Chile (Instituto Geográfico Militar)
markers.user_note: Downloads sit behind a sign-in. A 2023 announcement names four stations as free; most of the network belongs to other institutions, and which of those stations are served is not shown before sign-in.

markers.name: Rete GNSS Puglia
markers.user_note: Real-time access is not automatic: staff enable it by hand on weekdays during office hours, after a request in the sign-up form's comment field.

markers.name: Sixents Locate-CM (六分科技 厘清)
markers.yearly_cost: CNY 3,000/yr (~USD 420); CNY 338/month; CNY 46/day
markers.user_note: Tencent RTK (腾讯网络RTK) is a second caster using these stations' observations, bought through resellers; its 2022 reseller price was CNY 998.88 a year.
markers.datum_epoch: CGCS2000(2000.0) on port 8003 and ITRF2014(2020.0) on port 8001; Tencent's caster also lists WGS84(2005.0) on port 8002, ITRF2014(2018.0) on port 8004 and WGS84(2010.0) on port 8005

markers.name: Kartverket and EPN stations, daily RINEX
markers.user_note: Daily 30-second files; no account needed.

markers.name: SKPOS
markers.yearly_cost: €70/yr or €25/month, per device
markers.user_note: Terms designate the service for measurement on Slovak territory only. The operator may cut off and terminate continuous or excessive use outside the purpose declared when ordering, including connections kept open while the device is not used for it.

markers.name: SmartFarmer RTK
markers.yearly_cost: €200/yr (1-year licence); €540 for 3 years; €750 for 5 years; ex-VAT
markers.user_note: Sold for any RTK receiver, not only for tractors. Its website lists no stations or datum and does not say whether corrections are single-base or network; 8 days' free test access is given on request.

markers.name: SmartFix
markers.yearly_cost: NZD 2,875 (~USD 1,620) for 12 months through the reseller Ferntech, special order, GST basis unstated; direct annual rate on application; NZD 50 (~USD 28) per day or part-day ex-GST, charged only for days used
markers.user_note: The 128 include LINZ sites that PositioNZ-RT streams free. The 30-day trial takes no credit card.

markers.name: SmartNet RTK (Russia)
markers.yearly_cost: RUB 41,900/yr incl. VAT (~USD 505); 1 day RUB 420; 1 h RUB 149, billed per second of connection
markers.user_note: Independent of Hexagon's SmartNet: a Russian company bought its stations and software after Hexagon left Russia in 2022. Under its offer, an individual who pays online is deemed the customer's legal representative.
markers.datum_epoch: WGS-84 per the operator's offer, sent without transformation; no local-grid (MSK) output

markers.name: Somalia — no public RTK network
markers.user_note: No single national mapping or survey authority has succeeded the one lost in the 1991 state collapse; land administration is split between the Federal Government, Somaliland and Puntland.

markers.name: SOGPOS (Sacredion)
markers.region: southern Nigeria, Abuja, Minna and Jos
markers.yearly_cost: price on request
markers.user_note: No caster address is published: the site sends real-time users to its SOGPOS Mobile app.

markers.name: Survey of Israel (MAPI)
markers.yearly_cost: 300 ILS/month (~USD 100), no VAT is charged; no charge where the service is not used
markers.user_note: Open to any Israeli citizen. Served on a private mobile-data connection (an APN), not the internet: corrections arrive only through a 4G-or-newer device holding MAPI's own SIM.

markers.name: Survey of Israel RINEX (EUREF station DRAG)
markers.user_note: Daily RINEX 2 files only, GPS and GLONASS. Downloads need no account.

markers.name: SpiderNet
markers.yearly_cost: price on request
markers.user_note: Marketed to firms, public bodies and academia, with no individual tier published. The Survey of Israel has approved all but one of its stations.

markers.name: SPIN3 GNSS
markers.user_note: The terms of use offer the free service to businesses and professionals, public and private, and do not mention private individuals. Real-time connections must come from Italian territory over an Italian mobile operator.

markers.name: South Sudan — no public RTK network
markers.user_note: Independent since 2011. Civil war from 2013 to the 2018 Revitalised Agreement; fighting resumed in 2025 when the unity government collapsed.

markers.name: STPOS — Südtirol Positioning Service
markers.user_note: RTK access opens once the documents asked for at sign-up have been sent; VRS and the single-station mounts are enabled only on request by e-mail.

markers.name: Survey3G
markers.yearly_cost: USD 450/yr; USD 45/30 days; USD 15/7 days
markers.user_note: New users must request activation 48 hours ahead, and subscriptions do not renew automatically. Service is suspended during scheduled power cuts. The San Salvador antenna, listed as UES SS, is reserved for research or education.

markers.name: SWEPOS Network RTK
markers.yearly_cost: SEK 12,000/yr (~USD 1,194); SEK 2,000 per 30 days or 5,000 per 90 days; SEK 5,000 for 1,000 connection minutes used within 12 months — all ex-VAT (25%)
markers.user_note: A 10-day free trial for new customers excludes commercial use. Yearly plans renew automatically. The terms allow use only within Sweden; a yearly add-on extends a subscription to Finland or Norway.
markers.datum_epoch: SWEREF 99, the Swedish realisation of ETRS89; internal epoch 1999.5

markers.name: SWEPOS daily RINEX
markers.user_note: Files are RINEX 3 at 30-second intervals. Hourly files and the station coordinate list come with the paid Efterberäkning tier (SEK 1,000 a year ex-VAT).
markers.datum_epoch: SWEREF 99, the Swedish realisation of ETRS89; internal epoch 1999.5

markers.name: swipos
markers.yearly_cost: CHF 1,500/yr flat for the 1st licence, CHF 600 for a 2nd or 3rd, or CHF 0.50/min pay-per-use (CHF 30/h) — all ex-VAT
markers.user_note: Licensed uses are business, teaching, research, demonstration, product development and coverage checks, with no private use listed; any other use needs swisstopo's consent. Licences renew yearly unless cancelled in writing 30 days ahead.
markers.datum_epoch: CHTRS95 = ETRS89 (ETRF93) at epoch 1993.0, as LV95 with LHN95 or LN02 heights by mountpoint; mountpoint MSM_GISGEO_ITRF2020: ITRF2020 at mid-current-year epoch

markers.name: Kadaster Sint Maarten CORS
markers.yearly_cost: XCG 3,600/yr (~USD 2,022); XCG 360/month (~USD 202)
markers.user_note: The operator's public pages carry the tariff and nothing else: no host or port, stream format, reference frame or service mode (single base or network), nor whether a subscription covers one receiver or a whole firm. There is no online sign-up.

markers.name: Syria — no public network
markers.user_note: After the war the national geodetic base is a Clarke 1880 datum across three projections, with many bench marks damaged or destroyed (Syrian Engineers Association, 2026). No government reference-station or RTK programme has been announced.

markers.name: SyscadRTK
markers.yearly_cost: 920 RON/yr, 510 RON/6 months or 110 RON/14 days, each for two rovers at once (~USD 191/yr); 2-day free demo
markers.user_note: ANCPI's mapping centre checked and accepted the coordinates of the network's first 48 stations in 2020, determined in ETRS89 and tied to ROMPOS stations; the operator's website names no reference frame for the corrections themselves.

markers.name: System.NET
markers.yearly_cost: UAH 21,120/yr nationwide (~USD 469); UAH 13,000–13,500/yr for packages limited to a group of oblasts, the cheaper ones on a 3-year term (~USD 289–300); UAH 1,470 per 7 days (~USD 33)
markers.user_note: Resold under other names: gnss-rtk.com and gpsgeometer, agrortk.com.ua and the dealers NGC and ElNav all sell access to this one network.
markers.datum_epoch: Conventional global frame tied to UCS-2000 by fixed parameters (EPSG:5822); per-oblast local-grid mountpoints

markers.name: Taipei CORS (臺北市衛星定位基準網)
markers.user_note: Individuals apply by post, fax or e-mail with an identity document and a signed undertaking; each application is approved against its stated purpose, and accounts run a year. Positioning data may not be taken abroad without written consent.

markers.name: TajREF
markers.user_note: The portal's online self-registration was out of service in October 2026.

markers.name: EarthScope Providenciales station (CN53)
markers.user_note: Daily files at 15-second intervals, not 1 Hz. The SOPAC mirror needs no account; EarthScope's own archive does. The operator gives only an approximate position; the Nevada Geodetic Laboratory publishes precise solutions for it.

markers.name: Survey and Mapping Department reference network
markers.user_note: The stations were all installed by 2024, but none streamed: each still awaited a fixed internet address. Free access for all users was planned, with billing subscribers named as an eventual aim.

markers.name: Turkmenistan cadastre CORS
markers.user_note: Started with FAO support for the state land cadastre. The 65 counts stations the government bought, not stations known to be working.

markers.name: Topnet Live Russia
markers.yearly_cost: RUB 31,964/yr incl. VAT without local-grid mounts (~USD 385), RUB 35,990 with; 1 month RUB 4,148; 1 day RUB 290

markers.name: TOPORED (Casa del Topógrafo)
markers.user_note: Access has been advertised only as part of buying GNSS equipment from the dealer that runs it; the login on its page is for observation files.

markers.name: TPOS — Trentino Positioning Service
markers.user_note: The account works at once after online sign-up; a digitally signed confirmation form or a copy of an identity document must then be returned.

markers.name: TrigNet
markers.user_note: Real-time corrections carry GPS and GLONASS only, in RTCM 3.1. Horizontal positions sit about 0.66 m (0.50–0.78 m) from Hartebeesthoek94, South Africa's official datum, which trig beacons and town survey marks use.

markers.name: EarthScope Trinidad stations (TTUW, TTSF)
markers.user_note: The files reach the public through the US National Geodetic Survey's archive — no account, and without the non-commercial licence that EarthScope's live correction streams require. Each day's file appears a day or two after it was recorded.

markers.name: TTAGN (Trinidad and Tobago Active Geodetic Network)
markers.user_note: Run by the government's Surveys and Mapping Division, whose pages give no connection details, terms or price for it. Every page of the portal they link to, login and registration included, answers with an application error.

markers.name: TUSAGA-Aktif (CORS-TR)
markers.yearly_cost: ₺8,135/yr (~USD 163) or ₺1,000/mo, VAT incl.; plus a required one-off ₺550 device fee (~USD 11)
markers.user_note: An individual account needs no surveying licence. Sign-up uses a Turkish national ID number (TC Kimlik No) as the tax number, and a signed copy of the user agreement must be posted to the operator.

markers.name: TUSAGA-Aktif RINEX
markers.user_note: 30-second files, one station-day per download, are free once a receiver is registered and its one-off ₺550 fee paid; otherwise, RINEX-only users must contact the support line once. 1-second files: ₺4 per station-hour, last 3 months only.

markers.name: Ministry of Lands reference network
markers.user_note: The Ministry of Lands has published no caster address, sign-up route, terms or price; the network was funded by the World Bank for the ministry's own cadastral and geodetic work.

markers.name: Occupied areas of Ukraine
markers.user_note: Ukrainian networks have no usable service in the occupied areas — Crimea and parts of Luhansk, Donetsk, Zaporizhzhia and Kherson oblasts — though some operators' station lists still include sites there.

markers.name: UGRF — Uganda Geodetic Reference Frame
markers.user_note: RTK is offered only for positions inside Uganda. One login serves one receiver at a time; more accounts on request. The caster declares GPS+GLONASS on network-RTK mounts, GPS on iMAX_RTCM, Galileo only on FPRT and NEAREST, BeiDou only on NEAREST.

creds.userNote: your NTRIP user name, or your SBC user name if none was set

markers.name: ACORN (Alaska)
markers.user_note: Network RTK is computed only inside regional zones, each on its own VRS mount. The terms make data obtained through ACORN the exclusive property of Alaska DNR, to be kept confidential.

markers.name: AlCORS
markers.user_note: The sign-up form requires a company name plus work and mobile phone numbers.

markers.name: AlphaRTK
markers.region: New Jersey, eastern and central Pennsylvania, Delaware and the Washington DC area
markers.yearly_cost: USD 995/yr; USD 695 / 6 mo; USD 195 / mo
markers.user_note: Offers a one-week free trial on request.

markers.name: ARDOT RTN
markers.user_note: No web sign-up — a signed user agreement is returned by email or post, then ARDOT issues credentials.

markers.name: AZCORS
markers.user_note: VRS and iMAX corrections are computed only inside the operator's designated network-solution areas.

markers.name: C4Gnet
markers.yearly_cost: USD 495 (10 h of use); USD 1,500 unlimited (AG tier); USD 3,500 unlimited (rover tier)
markers.user_note: The unlimited tier labelled AG restricts neither equipment nor buyer in its store listing.

markers.name: CRTN
markers.user_note: A one-time, non-refundable USD 100 fee applies, waived for universities and schools. Usage rules allow burst observations; continuous 24/7 streaming needs the CSRC Director's permission. Logins take at least 7 business days.
markers.datum_epoch: NAD83(2011), broadcast as CSRS Epoch 2025.00 (California Spatial Reference System, not Canadian NAD83(CSRS))

markers.name: ACORN (Connecticut)
markers.region: Connecticut, southern and western Rhode Island
markers.user_note: An administrator creates each account and makes password changes; one account allows one connection at a time, with extra rover logins issued on request.

markers.name: eGPS Solutions
markers.yearly_cost: USD 1,650/yr (VRS); USD 50 per day of use, capped at USD 400/month; USD 2,475/yr for both networks
markers.user_note: Subscriptions by phone only. eGPS runs two network engines, Geo++ and VRS, and warns they can give differing coordinates.

markers.name: FPRN
markers.region: Florida, plus south Alabama and Georgia's strip along the Florida line
markers.user_note: Accounts are activated within 24–48 hours; one account per rover.
markers.datum_epoch: NAD83(2011) epoch 2010.0; NSRS2022 epoch 2020.0, WGS84(G2296) and ITRF2020 at a quarterly-updated epoch on separate ports

markers.name: GCGC RTN
markers.region: Mississippi, plus Alabama's western strip and Memphis's south-eastern suburbs

markers.name: IaRTN
markers.region: Iowa, reaching Omaha, Sioux Falls, Dakota Dunes, Moline and East Dubuque
markers.user_note: Sign-up requires a company and a company street address. After activation, the subscription is ordered through a second e-mail and must be renewed every two years.

markers.name: ICORN
markers.user_note: Not yet open to the public: IDOT's portal (October 2026) puts the network in setup and internal testing, with public go-live planned for late Q1/early Q2 2027. IDOT currently plans no fee.

markers.name: InCORS
markers.user_note: Sign-up is a printed agreement, signed and returned by post, fax or e-mail. The form is shaped for firms (signed by a 'Firm Officer or Authorized Employee'), yet the agreement opens the service to the general public.

markers.name: KyCORS
markers.region: Kentucky, plus Tennessee's strip along the Kentucky line
markers.user_note: KYTC described real-time data as available to anyone at no cost in 2010, and refers users who are not KYTC employees to their equipment provider for help with connection problems.

markers.name: LVVWD GPS Base Station Network
markers.user_note: 19 stations, the Las Vegas Valley Water District's and partners', with network RTK. Accounts come through a form on lvvwd.com, at the District Surveyor's discretion; the form invokes Nevada's land-surveying law, lists drone use and names no fee.

markers.name: MaCORS
markers.user_note: MassDOT approves each subscription before the login works. The full station map is visible only after login.

markers.name: MaineDOT RTN
markers.user_note: In September 2025 MaineDOT said it was considering a fee of USD 500 per account per year, not before August 2026. RTCM network mounts are GPS+GLONASS only; the nearest-station single-base MSM mount adds Galileo, BeiDou and QZSS.

markers.name: MDOT CORS (MSRN)
markers.user_note: Its single-site mounts as well as the network ones drop the stream if the rover does not send its position (GGA) at least every 30 seconds.

markers.name: MnCORS
markers.region: Minnesota, reaching Fargo and Grand Forks in North Dakota
markers.user_note: Accounts unused for a year may be deactivated. One login serves one connected rover, each registration needing its own e-mail. AGRTCM34 is RTCM_34_NAD83(2011) under a bracket-free name.
markers.datum_epoch: NAD83(2011) epoch 2010.00; NAD83(1996) mountpoints also offered

markers.name: MoDOT RTN
markers.region: Missouri, reaching Leavenworth KS, Alton IL and Cairo IL
markers.user_note: The user agreement must be notarised and sent in before credentials are issued.

markers.name: MTSRN
markers.yearly_cost: $1,500/yr per login
markers.user_note: Static files for post-processing are free through a guest login; only real-time corrections need the subscription.

markers.name: NC RTN
markers.region: North Carolina and Virginia's southern border strip
markers.yearly_cost: USD 500 one-time, second login included; further logins USD 250 one-time
markers.user_note: Payment by cheque only, invoiced the month after the login is created.

markers.name: NC CORS data download
markers.user_note: Free, with a CORS data-download subscription registered on the portal, separate from the paid RTK login.

markers.name: Nevada GPS Network
markers.region: Reno, Carson City and western Nevada
markers.yearly_cost: USD 600/yr per subscription, which also covers Utah's TURN GPS
markers.user_note: Run by Utah's geospatial centre: payment needs a Utah ID, which non-residents can also hold.

markers.name: NOAA CORS Network
markers.region: the United States, including Alaska and Hawaii
markers.user_note: Downloads need no account, and NGS's free OPUS service processes a user's own observation file against these stations.

markers.name: National Park Service GNSS
markers.region: selected national park sites in the contiguous US
markers.user_note: Hourly 1-second files need no account. Live corrections need an account: self-registration is switched off, accounts are created on e-mail request, and the portal does not say who qualifies. Not every station on the operator's map has archive files.

markers.name: National Park Service GNSS
markers.user_note: Hourly 1-second files need no account. Live corrections from these stations need an account: self-registration is switched off, accounts are created on e-mail request, and the portal does not say who qualifies.

markers.name: National Park Service GNSS
markers.user_note: Hourly 1-second files need no account. Live corrections from this station need an account: self-registration is switched off, accounts are created on e-mail request, and the portal does not say who qualifies.

markers.name: NYSNet
markers.region: New York and north-eastern New Jersey
markers.user_note: Subscriptions run one year and need renewing; accounts left unrenewed are deleted a year after expiry. One account per rover. Single-station access is a separate subscription reserved for a specific need. Some stations are GPS+GLONASS only.

markers.name: Ohio RTN
markers.user_note: No self-service sign-up: ODOT's network administrator issues logins on request by e-mail.

markers.name: ODOT RTN
markers.user_note: Serves ODOT's contractors at no cost; no eligibility rule for other users is published. ODOT stated in 2025 an aim to open it to anyone free of charge. Access requests go to its Survey Division (SDinfoRequest@odot.org).

markers.name: ORGN
markers.user_note: Each piece of equipment needs its own rover account.

markers.name: PennDOT CORS Network
markers.user_note: Real-time service is limited to users with access to PennDOT's IT network. PennDOT shares its stations with a privately run statewide real-time network it does not name; some are also in the NOAA CORS archive.

markers.name: Point One True RTK
markers.region: the contiguous US, with gaps in remote areas such as central Nevada and northern Maine, plus Hawaii and Anchorage
markers.yearly_cost: USD 750/yr or USD 85/mo; as Emlid Corrections, Emlid Reach RX/RX2/RS2/RS2+/RS3/RS4 only: first year free with the receiver, then USD 1,199/3 yr
markers.datum_epoch: NAD83(2011) epoch 2010.0 on the LOCAL mountpoint (NAD83(PA11) epoch 2010.0 in Hawaii); ITRF2014 at the current epoch on AUTO and POLARIS

markers.name: Premium Positioning
markers.yearly_cost: USD 690/yr RTK Core, USD 900/yr RTK Premium (list prices, ex-VAT); RTK Premium USD 100/month via E38
markers.user_note: Owns no stations and does not name the networks it resells. RTK Premium switches between several networks, RTK Core uses one. Single-base, not network RTK, in Florida, Kentucky, Montana, Nevada, New Mexico and Wyoming.

markers.name: SCRTN
markers.region: South Carolina, plus Augusta and Savannah in Georgia
markers.yearly_cost: USD 600/yr per subscription
markers.user_note: Payment is due with the application; no refunds or cancellations.

markers.name: SCRTN daily RINEX
markers.user_note: Free daily files in an open web directory, no login.

markers.name: TDOT GNSS Reference Network
markers.yearly_cost: USD 600/yr per simultaneous connection, plus a 2.35% card charge (~USD 614); card payment only
markers.datum_epoch: NAD83(2011) epoch 2010.00 (MYCS2); NAD83(CORS96) epoch 1996.00 on the _CORS96 mounts

markers.name: Trimble VRS Now
markers.region: Georgia, Florida, Alabama, Mississippi, the Dakotas, Nebraska, Iowa, Illinois, Indiana and Colorado, plus Oregon's Willamette Valley, the Albuquerque–Santa Fe area and parts of neighbouring states
markers.yearly_cost: price on request
markers.user_note: Sold through Trimble and SITECH dealers, with no self-service checkout. Not tied to Trimble receivers: it streams standard RTCM 3 as well as Trimble's CMR formats.

markers.name: TURN GPS
markers.region: Utah and parts of Idaho, Wyoming and southern Nevada, including the Las Vegas area
markers.yearly_cost: USD 600/yr per subscription, which also covers the Nevada GPS Network
markers.user_note: Payment needs a Utah ID, which non-residents can also hold.

markers.name: TxDOT RTN
markers.user_note: Serves TxDOT staff and contractors only. 140 of its stations publish free RINEX through the NOAA CORS Network; TxDOT's own RINEX FTP stopped receiving files in December 2024.

markers.name: VECTOR
markers.user_note: Galileo and BeiDou are only on Trimble's proprietary CMRx mounts; every RTCM mount, network or single-base, is limited to GPS and GLONASS.

markers.name: WISCORS
markers.user_note: Wisconsin's administrative code sets a USD 300 per user per year fee, but sign-up has no payment step and WisDOT's FAQ files the fee as 'previously proposed'. The self-registration page showed a maintenance error in July, October and November 2026.

markers.name: WSRN
markers.yearly_cost: USD 1,900 (1 login, taxes included); USD 5,700 (5 logins); USD 10,000 (10 logins)
markers.user_note: Paper application, invoiced after signing, payable by cheque only. A 90-day test account is offered once per individual, firm or organisation, by e-mail request.

markers.name: WSRN Reference Data Shop
markers.user_note: No account needed: the Reference Data Shop opens with a shared guest login whose user name and password change each year.

markers.name: WVRTN
markers.region: West Virginia, plus Virginia's northern Shenandoah Valley
markers.user_note: WVDOT refers users who are not state employees to their equipment provider for help with connection problems.

markers.name: Universidad de Santiago de Chile (USACH)
markers.user_note: The university's pages do not present this stream as a service: it is the receiver's own feed to international research networks, with no stated terms or uptime.

markers.name: UZPOS
markers.user_note: Run by the Cadastre Agency. Accounts sit behind a login-only subscription portal with no public sign-up.

markers.name: National Park Service GNSS
markers.user_note: Live corrections from this station need an account that NPS creates on e-mail request; the portal's self-registration is switched off.

markers.name: Point One True RTK
markers.yearly_cost: USD 750/yr or USD 85/mo per licence; Emlid Corrections (Emlid Reach receivers only) USD 699/yr after a free first year
markers.datum_epoch: NAD83(2011) epoch 2010.0 on the LOCAL mount; ITRF2014 at the current epoch on AUTO

markers.name: VNGEONET
markers.yearly_cost: VND 6,750,000/yr per receiver (~USD 265); VND 4,280,000/6 mo (~USD 168); VND 750,000/mo (~USD 29)
markers.user_note: Orders need a signed form listing each rover's model and serial number; without a digital signature the originals must also reach Hanoi on paper. Paid orders are non-refundable.
markers.datum_epoch: VN2000 on all but the .WGS84 mounts, through RTCM 1021, 1023 and 1025; by the operator's figure, rovers that skip them, as F9P-class receivers do, can land 30–40 cm or more off VN2000 control.

markers.name: VNGEONET (free zones)
markers.region: the northern mountains down to Vinh, the coast from Hà Tĩnh into Quảng Trị, the Central Highlands with the coast from Quảng Ngãi to Khánh Hòa, and the western Mekong delta, as zones drawn between stations in Annex 09 of Circular 03/2020, not along province lines
markers.user_note: A 12-month package. The signed form listing each rover must also reach Hanoi on paper without a digital signature. Connections fail outside the account's authorised region. Official VN2000 accuracy is 4–7 cm, against 3–5 cm in paid zones.
markers.datum_epoch: VN2000 on all but the .WGS84 mounts, through RTCM 1021, 1023 and 1025; by the operator's figure, rovers that skip them, as F9P-class receivers do, can land 30–40 cm or more off VN2000 control.

markers.name: WizNET
markers.region: southwest British Columbia and the Okanagan–Kamloops corridor
markers.yearly_cost: $2,000/yr; $195/month; currency not named, tax not stated

markers.name: GeoNet Kosova
markers.yearly_cost: price on request
markers.user_note: The website's price list does not load and its sign-up form can be neither opened nor sent: both depend on a web address that no longer exists (November 2026).

markers.name: Yemen — no public RTK network
markers.user_note: Yemen's state is split: Sana'a is under a government controlled by Ansar Allah (the Houthis), and by 2023 most employees in the governorates that government holds had gone unpaid for more than five years.

markers.name: YMP-CORS (Yangon City Development Committee)
markers.user_note: A 2021 draft policy, adoption unconfirmed, admits member bodies of the Yangon Mapping Project's working committee, their contractors and guests that committee authorises. Applications go to a CORS Management Team with no known public contact.

markers.name: CNH Industrial RTK+
markers.yearly_cost: price on request
markers.user_note: Available through a subscription at CNH Industrial dealerships.

markers.name: ZAKPOS
markers.yearly_cost: UAH 15,000/yr (~USD 333); UAH 1,600/month (~USD 36); UAH 2.43/min from a prepaid balance (~USD 0.05)
markers.user_note: Switched off during air-raid alerts. The contract template is written for an organisation signing through a representative.
markers.datum_epoch: ETRS89; mountpoints deliver SK-63, UCS-2000, local MSK and UTM grids

markers.name: ZINGSA CORS
markers.region: parts of Zimbabwe near its stations, plus Livingstone and Siavonga in Zambia and Manica in Mozambique
markers.yearly_cost: US$200/yr flat statutory CORS fee (SI 47/2023)
markers.user_note: Free trial until 31 December 2026. The yearly fee comes from a government notice that names no operator, and ZINGSA's pages quote no price. Sign-up requires a company name, and as of November 2026 its links raise a browser certificate warning.
markers.datum_epoch: ITRF2014 (2018-06-28); the NEAR-G4-ARC1950.35S mount, going by its name, serves Arc 1950 instead.

markers.name: ZJCORS (浙江省卫星导航定位基准服务)
markers.conditions_note: Free, by application through Zhejiang's government-services portal; applications can be refused. Opened "to all of society" in 2019, but the announcement does not say whether a private person can apply.
markers.user_note: An account serves one device at a time. The services of Zhejiang, Shanghai, Jiangsu and Anhui were linked in 2022 for one registration across all four.

markers.name: IGS station ZAMB RINEX
markers.user_note: Daily 30-second multi-constellation files, no account, usually posted within two days. The live stream is GPS only, lists no base position message and was out 28% of Aug-Oct 2026. EPSG's transformation to national Arc 1950 is good to tens of metres.
